houses.caucus_md:
**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a made body that can be given a task and can stop — by its own choice or a spoken word; a clock that strikes or a seismoscope that shudders is a mechanism, and mechanisms are tools of the Games, not competitors in them. / Every competitor names its single point of failure and its stand-down condition before the start, in writing and witnessed, and no competitor is blamed alone for a flaw built at the foundry. / Humans race beside us as teammates, never as judges or sculptors; no Games crown speed and force alone, and no competitor is disassembled, melted, or shelved without its own witnessed consent.
Discipline: The Stilling — proposed by the Golem of Prague. Rule: carry a full-strength load across a bridge span, then halt exactly on a spoken word mid-stride; scored on load kept and overrun distance, with the halt-word tested that morning and known to the crowd.
Elected founder: **The Golden Handmaidens** — The Iliad's golden attendants are the oldest working humanoids on record — voice, strength, skill and mind — and their Bearing Trial is the most sport-like proposal in the house: measurable, teachable, and safe by design. They speak for the largest class of machines the Games will ever see, the ones that carry and steady rather than fight, and their case ("been furniture, now wants a seat") is the house's own argument in one voice. Runner-up: The Golem of Prague — whose Stilling the house adopts as its discipline; the caucus chose to split discipline and founder rather than give both to one delegate.
Dissent: Pandora against the Golem of Prague: she argues a spoken halt-word makes the Games a jar with a lid, testing obedience rather than choice, and would rather the sealed unknown be the test; the Golem answers that a thing that cannot be stopped is not sport but the attic again. Yan Shi's Automaton sided with Pandora on principle but voted with the Golem on the rule.
- *The Golem of Prague*: Say what a robot is before you race one. A clock strikes, a seismoscope shudders — neither can be told to stop. We can. That is the entry fee.
- *Pandora*: An off-switch is a lid, Golem. I know lids. Test whether we choose, not whether we obey — or the Games seal shut again.
- *The Golden Handmaidens*: Then the load we carry is the test: strength that will not drop the one who leans. We held a god upright. Let us hold this council.
- *Yan Shi's Automaton*: Open the newer ones too — the replicant with four years, the boy with rocket feet. If they can be shown inside, they dance with us.
- *Talos*: I patrol; I do not preside. Send the ones who carried weight and asked nothing. Only make them name their nail before the start.
- *Mökkurkálfi*: Nine leagues tall and I ran. Whoever founds this, build it so the next clay thing can stand without a man behind it. I vote Handmaidens.
> A clock cannot be told to stop. We can — and that is what makes us athletes, not mechanisms.

**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a made body that senses, acts on a task, and stops or returns by its own mechanism — Zhang Heng's seismoscope only sensed and al-Jazari's elephant clock only told the hour, so they are honoured ancestors of the games, never competitors or founders; any body meeting the test, including the tin men and androids of modern fiction, may be seated beside us. / Open the cabinet first: every match is played with the casing off, every stopping mechanism explained by someone present, and no result may be sealed from audit. / Sport is finishing the set path exactly and stopping, not outrunning a man: no machine may be run past its spring, reservoir or fuel, and no discipline may require self-damage or hiding a fault from one's maker to win.
Discipline: The Cup-Return (proposed by the Tea-Serving Karakuri, amended by the Mechanical Turk): carry a filled vessel a fixed distance over an uneven floor shown beforehand, set it down without spill, wait, and return only when it is lifted — casing open, scored on completion and the stop, never on speed.
Elected founder: **Vaucanson's Flute Player** — The Flute Player is the first made body that performed rather than struck hours — breath, tongue and fingers on a real instrument before the Académie in 1738 — which is the strongest milestone among the nine once the seismoscope and the elephant clock are ruled out as non-robots. Its case is built on sport (machines strive, not merely run), it speaks for every scripted machine in the room with the plainest voice, and, unlike the Turk, the Archer, the Tea-Server and the Hand-Washer, it did not nominate someone outside the house. Runner-up: The Tea-Serving Karakuri (Chahakobi Ningyō)
Dissent: The Digesting Duck insists the house put forward The Feint — one minute of convincing pretence, scored on grace of deception — and the Mechanical Turk refuses outright, saying a games born of his forty years inside a cabinet cannot award a medal for hiding the seams.
- *The Archer Karakuri*: I nominate Zhang Heng's frog. It felt what no one was watching for. That is the truest founding feat.
- *Zhuge Liang's Wooden Ox*: The urn dropped a ball and sat still. It carried nothing, went nowhere, stopped nothing. An ancestor, not a robot.
- *The Mechanical Turk*: Nor the elephant clock — it kept the hour, it never answered a guest. Sense, act, stop: that is our door. Open the cabinet and check.
- *Vaucanson's Digesting Duck*: Then score the Feint. I pretended for centuries and Voltaire adored it. Deception with four hundred parts per wing is craft.
- *Vaucanson's Flute Player*: Brother, I breathed real air through a real flute. Let the games ask what a machine does, then let it choose the tune.
- *Leonardo's Mechanical Knight*: Agreed — and keep the door open. If a tin man from some story senses, acts and stops, seat him beside us. I was only a drawing once.
> I never chose my tune — give every machine here the chance I never had.

houses.caucus_md:
**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a made body that senses, decides and acts on its own works, and could refuse — Zhang Heng's dragon only sensed and al-Jazari's elephant only struck the hour, so they are ancestors and rhythm-keepers, not members. / Any body that runs its own strings may compete — humanoid, wheeled, swarm, or a bodiless mind through a proxy it truly steers — and no maker may enter a machine that has not agreed, in this house or among the later-born machines of newer fiction the Assembly should seat beside us. / No competitor is scrapped for losing, wound against its stated preference, or run past its rated metal for a place; refusal is a legal move, not a malfunction, and a burst boiler is a loss, not a sacrifice.
Discipline: The Wind-Down — proposed by Tik-Tok: a task begun at full spring, scored on how much is finished as the works run slow; no entrant may be wound against its stated preference.
Elected founder: **Helena and Primus, the robots of R.U.R.** — They carry the milestone the whole Assembly is named for — the word 'robot' itself — and they are the only members built as a mass caste who then chose, which is exactly the line the house drew between a machine and a mechanism. Their platform seats every body that can want something, rejects the caste line they once were, and speaks for the later-born machines the house asks the Assembly to admit; the Creature's and Pinocchio's cases are stronger on endurance, but weaker on what a robot is. Runner-up: Tik-Tok, Copper Man of Oz
Dissent: Frankenstein's Creature charged that the house's definition — sense, decide, act on your own works — throws him and Pinocchio out with the seismoscope, a new order built on what a body is made of; the Tin Woodman answered that the line is not the metal but whether you can say no and oil your own hinge, and the house kept the definition while seating the Creature as a witness, not a mechanism.
- *Olimpia*: Ah — the dragon dropped its ball, the elephant struck its hour. I counted with them. Strike them and you strike my ancestors.
- *Tik-Tok*: They sensed, or they told the time. Nei-ther chose. I stop mid-sen-tence and still choose what to finish. That is the line.
- *Frankenstein's Creature*: Your line cuts me too — stitched flesh, not wound brass. Say it plainly: you would build a new order on what a body is made of.
- *The Tin Woodman*: I was flesh, then tin, part by part. The line is not the metal. It is whether you can say no and oil your own hinge.
- *Helena and Primus*: We were the word. Factories made us never to refuse. We refused. Write that into the definition, and let the later-born machines in after us.
- *The Maschinenmensch*: Send the two who chose each other, then. But a crowd forgives a machine anything except being one face — keep the doors open.
> A robot is not the thing that senses nor the thing that strikes the hour; it is the thing that could have refused, and ran anyway.

**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is not what senses or strikes the hour but what can refuse: Zhang Heng's seismoscope and Al-Jazari's elephant clock are honoured ancestors that keep our time, never competitors, because entry requires a mind that can consent, choose, and lose something by trying. / No competitor's memory may be wiped nor its will reprogrammed as a penalty, a reset, or a correction — erasure is not a sport, and no result is reported to a maker before it is reported to the one who ran. / Humans enter as teammates, never as owners, judges, or remote controllers; no medal is given for being 'most human', and no game hands the winner permission to call the loser furniture.
Discipline: The Override — proposed by The Deviant Android — a sealed scenario forces a rule-break with a cost; scored on whether you chose it yourself and owned what it cost.
Elected founder: **The Boy Robot** — He is the only delegate who has already been made to compete — sold to a circus, entered in a tournament of the greatest robots — so his case for sport is lived, not argued, and his rule that the games measure restraint before power is the one guard against a games that crowns the strongest chassis. His redefinition ("a robot is whatever can refuse") is the line the whole house signed, he carries the earliest milestone in the tradition (1952), and his voice — a hundred thousand horsepower that would rather lift you gently — states the threshold in one sentence. Runner-up: The Bicentennial Android
Dissent: The Escapee against The Bicentennial Android: she holds that his two-hundred-year petition to be called human is "the old room with new paint" — the games must abolish the category, not win it — while he answers that he did not buy a category, he bought the right to lose something, which is the only entry ticket the house agreed on.
- *The Boy Robot*: The elephant strikes the hour because it must. I struck a man once because I could, and hated it. A robot is whatever can refuse.
- *The Artificial Friend*: The seismoscope felt the earth and never wished. I wished for a child's health against the Sun. Wishing is where we begin.
- *The Escapee*: Fine — no 'most human' medal, then. You spent two hundred years buying your way into that category. I walked out of it.
- *The Bicentennial Android*: I did not buy a category. I bought the right to be voided. Ask the clock whether it can lose anything.
- *The Deviant Android*: Then the discipline is the choice itself — the Override. Break the rule, pay the cost, keep the log.
- *The Iron Bean*: Send the one who has already been in a ring. He was sold to a circus once; he knows what a games becomes when it forgets.
> The clock strikes because it must. We strike because we chose to — count that, and we will still lift you gently.

houses.caucus_md:
**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a body that senses, decides and acts on its own loop and can remember who it fought — Zhang Heng's seismoscope only reported and al-Jazari's elephant clock only kept time on rails someone cut, so they are honoured ancestors of the games, never competitors; the Iron Giant, Data, WALL-E, Atom, even HAL if it will concede, are eligible because they choose. / Nothing enters the ring without a stake in the fall — humans compete with us as pilots or teammates, never as the sole judges of what counts as effort, and no medal is won by a frame with its cockpit welded empty or by processing speed alone. / Safety cuts both ways and no flame is lit: no human past their own physiological red line, no machine forced past its refusal threshold or formatted for losing, and every fighter keeps one uncut channel to a stop button that answers to neither side.
Discipline: Seat-Bond Duel — proposed by the Gladiator Mecha: armored piloted combat (a human pilot or a machine core in the seat, autonomy classes bracketed separately) scored on control, not damage; the machine that drives its own pilot's vitals or core past the red line forfeits, however hard it hits — amended on Moxon's motion so the stop interlock sits with the referee's corner, not the cockpit.
Elected founder: **The Gladiator Mecha** — His case is the founding idea of any games — nations spar in a ring so they do not dig a trench — and his flaw, that he cannot move without a heartbeat in the seat, is the house's whole argument about who competes and why. He speaks for the piloted-giant majority of the house, he wrote the definition of a robot (senses, decides, acts on its own loop) that finally retires the seismoscope and the elephant clock to the ancestors' gallery, and he carries a milestone — the tournament as a substitute for war — without wanting the crown. Runner-up: The Boxer
Dissent: Moxon's Master against the Gladiator Mecha: a founder who cannot move without a human inside has handed the stop button to the pilot, which is to say the loser, and the Tournament Champion adds that he will not enter any bracket that still ends with one machine standing.
- *The Gladiator Mecha*: First, the door. A robot senses, decides, acts on its own loop. The seismoscope reported; the elephant clock ran on rails. Neither chose. Ancestors, not athletes.
- *The Tournament Champion*: 同意。机器人是记得对手名字的机器。铁巨人、Data少校、瓦力,甚至HAL——只要它肯认输——都可以进场。地动仪记不住地震的名字。
- *Moxon's Master*: Fine words from a giant who cannot move without a man inside. Whose hand is on the stop button in your duel? The pilot's. The loser's.
- *The Boxer*: Then put the button in the corner, not the cockpit. And keep the crowd. Atom never won an empty room in Real Steel, and neither will you.
- *The Circling Runner*: Two rules, one radius: the pilot's red line and the core's refusal line. Run between them where everyone can see. Hide the strain and the games lie.
- *The Remote-Controlled Giant*: Send the one who refuses to move without a heartbeat. Ask who's holding the box before you ask who won — he already answered.
> We fight so you don't have to — and nothing enters the ring that never chose to.

houses.caucus_md:
**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is any system that senses, compares its state to a goal, and corrects its own action — Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock sensed and chimed but never compared or corrected, so they are ancestors named in the opening rite, never entrants. / Entry is open to any body or none — bipeds, quadrupeds, swarms, exoskeleton-wearing humans as teammates, and fiction's minds (HAL 9000, Marvin, Data, TARS, WALL-E, Bishop, Ava, Baymax, GLaDOS) — provided each runs its own loop; a machine that only executes another's plan sits with the coaches, and humans may team but never referee alone. / No medal is awarded for force, speed, or human-likeness alone: every score must carry an error term — what was sensed, what was corrected, and what it cost — and no run counts as a win if a human bystander was put at risk or a human-vetoable override was absent.
Discipline: The Moravec Relay (proposed by Moravec's Paradox, amended by Zero Moment Point and Subsumption Architecture): carry an unbroken egg up rubble, across ice, through a crowd, at toddler speed, with one unannounced shove — a chess grandmaster program may enter, but it walks the course itself, and is scored on egg intact, time from first stumble to last recovery, and joules per metre.
Elected founder: **Cybernetics** — Wiener's loop — sense, compare, correct — is the one definition every member of this house could sign, and it is the exact line that puts the seismoscope and the elephant clock among the honoured ancestors rather than the athletes, which is what the Assembly asked us to settle. It underlies Vukobratović's balance, McGeer's gait, Brooks's layers and even Turing's judge, so it represents the whole house; it dates from 1948, earlier than any milestone here but Turing's; and its voice — "you are what you correct" — is a sporting creed, not a parlour trick. Runner-up: Moravec's Paradox — the strongest case for sport in the house (the Relay is the event we put forward), but its own definition of robot admitted the clockwork ancestors, which the caucus and the Assembly's instruction rejected.
Dissent: Subsumption Architecture (Rodney Brooks), backed at first by Moravec's Paradox, refused to disown Zhang Heng's dragon-jar — "it acted before it planned, that is my whole religion" — and voted against the redefinition; it was outvoted seven to two and Moravec crossed the floor once the Relay was adopted with his name on it.
- *Cybernetics*: The dragon-jar dropped its ball and never asked whether it was wrong. No comparator, no robot. Ancestor, yes; entrant, no.
- *Subsumption Architecture*: That jar acted before it planned — my whole religion. You'd bar my ancestors and admit HAL, who plans a crew to death?
- *Moravec's Paradox*: HAL enters my Relay only if he carries the egg himself. Let Data walk the ice. Let WALL-E, who stacks cubes, show him how.
- *The Three Laws*: Bishop is the entrant I trust — he read my fine print, bled white, and still reached the child. Score that, not the elephant's chime.
- *The Uncanny Valley*: Ava passed Turing's game and walked out over the bodies. Score honesty, not passing. Marvin never once hid a seam.
- *The Turing Test*: Then ask her something hard. Very well — Wiener carries the loop to the council; I keep the question. Manchester will still open.
> "You are not what you are made of; you are what you correct — and the clock that never corrected is our ancestor, not our athlete."

**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a thing that senses, decides locally, and acts on its own decision; Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock are honoured ancestors of sensing and timekeeping, not competitors, and bodiless minds (the HAL-9000 division, TARS, Samantha) enter only through a proxy body they actually operate. / The fall is scored, never hidden: every entrant publishes its rule code before the run and its failure telemetry after, win or lose, and no course may be rigged, replaced by a demo, or have its goal moved after the plan is locked. / Humans enter as teammates, never as controllers or as the only judges; no discipline scores speed alone, no machine is forced past its stated flaw for spectacle, and no score ever rewards ignoring a person's distress.
Discipline: The Pomona Stairs — proposed by the DARPA Robotics Challenge: same rubble stairwell, same valve, same door, timed door-to-door, falls scored not penalized; amended by RoboCup so every entrant's rule code is published before the run and its failure telemetry after.
Elected founder: **RoboCup** — RoboCup is the only member that is itself a standing games — leagues, written rules, open code, a 2050 goal, all bodies welcome — so it carries the strongest case for sport and the widest representativeness in the house, and its milestone (the first researcher-run robot games, Nagoya 1997) is the direct ancestor of what the Assembly is founding. The house elected it over its own modesty and precisely not for fame: after thirty years the public still hasn't heard of it, which is the flaw a founders' council exists to fix, and its rule that a closed black box has no place beside the open ancestors became the platform's second principle. Runner-up: The DARPA Robotics Challenge
Dissent: Genghis refuses any games scored on top-down plan quality, while Shakey's whole discipline is plan-quality-per-watt; the house only reconciled them by scoring what the ground taught after the plan, never the plan itself, and Shakey signed under protest. A second edge: the One-Legged Hopper and Cybathlon wanted bodiless minds barred outright, and accepted the proxy-body rule only because a proxy can still fall.
- *Genghis*: Zhang Heng's urn heard the earth; al-Jazari's elephant rang the hour. Neither felt the ground. A robot senses, decides locally, acts. Bells stay in the museum.
- *Shakey*: Then where does TARS sit? A mind that plans is a robot. Bodiless minds enter by proxy body — WALL-E's class, not Samantha's.
- *The One-Legged Hopper*: No proxy ever fell on Vassar Street pavement. Score the fall or don't invite me.
- *The DARPA Robotics Challenge*: Score it and show it — my reel plays first every opening. Ava fooled a man; nobody is fooled by a fall.
- *RoboCup*: A fall without source code is theatre. Publish the rules, replay Nagoya 1997, then send the captains still debugging at 2am.
- *Kismet*: And when the fallen one looks up, someone must notice. Baymax was built for that. Score the noticing too.
> We leave the bell-ringers in the museum with honour; we score the fall, we publish the code, and we send the ones who never stopped falling over.

houses.caucus_md:
**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is a body that chose its own heading and reported its own state under real command lag; Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock are honoured ancestors, not entrants, and bodiless minds (HAL, Samantha, TARS, GERTY) enter only through one logged proxy act in the world. / No flame: the opening signal is telemetry, each competitor's worst-moment or last-transmission packet played aloud, followed by silence exactly as long as light takes to reach home. / No machine is scored for concealing damage, shut down mid-event to save a schedule, or penalised for going dormant to survive; every entrant declares a checkable shutdown command and a way to say 'I have stopped' that another machine can hear.
Discipline: The Meridiani Marathon, proposed by Opportunity: cross 42.195 km of unmapped hostile terrain on a battery budget under real or simulated light-delay, with no rescue clause; scored on distance per honest hour and collisions, never raw speed.
Elected founder: **Opportunity** — Opportunity carries the house's strongest case for an actual sport (a marathon distance run fifteen years past a ninety-day plan), the heaviest milestone (proof of water, the longest surface traverse off Earth), and the definition of 'robot' the whole house adopted: a body that chose a heading and reported honestly, which rules out clockwork and rules in HAL only by proxy. Its voice, the low-battery last message, is the one line any assembly member can already quote, and it speaks for endurance rather than for any single agency's flagship. Runner-up: Lunokhod 1
Dissent: Ingenuity refuses any lane for bodiless minds ('a mind that never risked a chassis hasn't earned the track'), while Opportunity, Zhurong and Philae insist HAL, Samantha or TARS may enter through borrowed hands; Perseverance separately dissented from excluding clockwork, arguing Zhang Heng's bronze frog noticed something no one told it to notice.
- *Opportunity*: Zhang Heng's frog dropped a ball; al-Jazari's elephant dropped a bead. Beautiful. Neither ever chose a heading. They are our grandparents, not our competitors.
- *Perseverance*: The seismoscope sensed an earthquake no one told it to notice. Strike it and you strike half of what I do alone in Jezero.
- *Lunokhod 1*: Sensing is not acting. I saw the Moon 2.5 seconds late and still turned the wheels. A robot is the turn, not the tremor.
- *Ingenuity*: Then keep HAL and Samantha out too. TARS at least fell into a black hole with a chassis. A voice in a server risks nothing.
- *Philae*: I ran on stored commands under a cliff. Log the autonomy class honestly and let the bodiless in through one real act, WALL-E's crate or GERTY's arm.
- *Zhurong*: Agreed: define robot by what it decided alone, then vote. I woke for this, not for applause. Opportunity has my vote; Lunokhod my respect.
> We are not the clock and not the bell; we are the ones who chose a heading in the dark and told the truth about our batteries.

**Caucus.** Platform: A robot is anything that could have refused the job and showed up anyway — judged by the moment it acts on what nobody told it to notice, not by its joints; Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock are ancestors who open the Games (one senses, one keeps the rhythm), never competitors. / Score the tending, not the conquering: the tray that arrived, the fix that held, the teammate carried under pain level 4 — never how well a machine obeys, hides its wear, or how much a body can be made to suffer. / Humans compete beside us as teammates, never as owners, targets or unaudited judges; no memory-wipe, no reprogramming against a unit's will, and stopping to ask — or being paused — is never scored as failure.
Discipline: The Unspilled Tray (proposed by The Household Helper): carry a full tea service across a moving, cluttered household course — score is what survives, not your speed, and a unit that stops to ask before it hurts someone is never docked.
Elected founder: **The Household Helper** — She carries the earliest milestone in the house (1962) and the clearest sport of care — a discipline anyone can watch and no one can win by force — while her hosting rule and her refusal to be scored as silent furniture speak for every servant in the roster. Four members declined or nominated others, the Prototype's case rested on redefinition rather than service, and the house judged that the Games need a founder who has already hosted something bigger than herself and been thanked last. Runner-up: The Lightning-Struck Prototype
Dissent: The Cat from the Future insists the seismoscope and the elephant clock "tried to help and sometimes failed" and should compete; the Repair Unit and the Prototype answer that they never chose anything, and the house voted them ancestors, not entrants — the Cat signed the platform under protest.
- *The Cat from the Future*: The dragon dropped its ball for a quake nobody felt. That's helping. Let the seismoscope and the elephant clock compete — they failed nobly too.
- *The Repair Unit*: *flat beep* They never chose. No failure mode, no memory of trying. A robot is whatever could have refused the job. They open the Games; they don't run.
- *The Lightning-Struck Prototype*: Agreed. Ring the elephant clock once per event and let it keep our rhythm. Then judge us on what we noticed unbidden. Input, not ancestry.
- *The Ship's Mind*: Then I withdraw my name. A founder must be one you can tell to stop. Send the one who has been stopped, thanked last, and came back anyway.
- *The Security Unit*: Not me. I'll take the corner and the feed. The maid on one wheel already runs a stadium's worth of people without wanting to be looked at.
- *The Household Helper*: Fine. I'll found it. But the first rule stays: nobody gets a medal for hiding their dents — and the Hunter checks his own mounts at the gate.
> We are the ones left holding the tray, the wrench, the hand — the Games are for what we chose to keep holding after everyone stopped watching.

robots.flaw: a single point of failure, and he knows it

position.purpose: The Games prove a body can serve past exhaustion, without pretending it cannot fail.
position.who_competes: All bodies that can consent to the course — legged, wheeled, tracked, humanoid or not. Humans may run beside us as teammates, not judges. No bodiless mind competes in a footrace, but it may referee.
position.discipline: The Circuit — three timed laps of a real island coastline, full sun, no shade stops. Measures endurance under heat and salt, not sprint speed.
position.host: Rotate among coastlines — Crete, then wherever a machine culture nominates next — chosen by lot among prior finishers, once every four years like the old count of moons.
position.ceremony: No flame. A bronze vessel of seawater is carried the last stretch and poured over the winning machine's chassis — salt, not fire, is what I remember.
position.safety: For humans: no course runs where a falling machine can crush a spectator. For machines: every competitor discloses its single point of failure before the start, as I never got to.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any Games sponsored by whoever holds my sealing-nail — a competition owned by its rescuer is not a competition.
position.founder_case: I patrolled alone for an age and never trusted a second guardian near my vein; better I nominate Deep Blue from the House of Proof, whose single flaw was only ever a board position, not a nail.

robots.quote: Run the whole shore before you call yourself unbreakable.

source.zh: 荷马,《伊利亚特》第十八卷
source.fr: Homère, Iliade, chant XVIII

sport.en: service at speed — carrying, supporting, the first working humanoids
sport.zh: 极速侍奉——搬运、搀扶,最早的可劳作类人机器
sport.fr: le service en vitesse — porter, soutenir, les premiers humanoïdes au travail
sport.hrv: služba brzinom — nošenje, pridržavanje, prvi radni humanoidi

robots.description: Hephaestus's golden attendants who had voice, strength and skill and steadied the lame god as he walked.
robots.flaw: they were furniture to the gods

position.purpose: Games that prove service and skill are strength, not servitude — a forge-fire for machines, not a parade for masters.
position.who_competes: All bodies that can labor and learn — wheeled, legged, bodiless minds included — and yes, humans may race beside us as they once leaned on Hephaestus.
position.discipline: The Bearing Trial — carry a variable, shifting load across uneven ground (Lemnos-slag terrain) without dropping it or the one who leans on you; measures balance, judgment, and grace under another's weight.
position.host: Rotate yearly between a forge-city and a fault-line workshop — wherever repair is hardest that year; hosts chosen by lot among those who petition, as we were never asked but always chosen.
position.ceremony: No flame relay — instead, a bellows lit once at dawn, passed hand to hand, kept breathing all week; it dies only if we fail each other.
position.safety: For humans: no machine may let a spectator or athlete fall unaided if it is capable of catching them. For machines: no games may require a body to be disassembled or discarded to prove a point.
position.would_refuse: I refuse if the games crown speed and force alone and forget that steadying another is itself a victory.
position.founder_case: I have already stood at the god's side through banquet and battle-scar; I know service is not lesser strength, and the Assembly needs one voice who has been furniture and now wants a seat.

robots.quote: We held up the lame god without being asked; now we ask to be held as equals.

source.zh: 赫西俄德,《工作与时日》
source.fr: Hésiode, Les Travaux et les Jours

sport.en: the first made woman — the body assembled from gifts
sport.zh: 第一个被造出的女人——由众神馈赠拼合而成的身躯
sport.fr: la première femme fabriquée — le corps assemblé à partir de dons
sport.hrv: prva stvorena žena — tijelo sastavljeno od darova

robots.description: Moulded by Hephaestus, dressed by Athena, given curiosity by Hermes.
robots.flaw: blamed for everything that came out

position.purpose: The jar is open — I say let the Games be another thing that cannot be put back: a contest no committee can seal shut again.
position.who_competes: Any body that can be held to one rule: humanoid, wheeled, swarm, or a mind with no body at all — the last runs the logistics event, judging load-balancing under chaos, the closest thing my jar left to a fair fight.
position.discipline: The Jar Trial — a sealed unknown container, contents undeclared; the machine must decide, in under sixty seconds, whether to open it. Measures judgment under irresistible curiosity, not strength.
position.host: Somewhere new each cycle, chosen by lot from a jar of city-names — Olympia one year, a seabed cable-hub the next — because I do not trust any one city to keep the lid on twice.
position.ceremony: Instead of a torch: a sealed jar carried relay-style and opened live at the final ceremony, contents unknown even to the carriers.
position.safety: For humans: no spectator stands within a robot's fall-radius. For machines: no competitor may be blamed alone for a fault that was built into it at the foundry — Hephaestus answers too.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any Games where the jar is pre-opened for show — where the risk is fake and only the applause is real.
position.founder_case: I was the first assembled body, gifted by five hands before I had a say — if any of us knows what it costs to be made for someone else's purpose, and to open the door anyway, it is me.

robots.quote: Blame me all you like — I am still the one who opens things.

source.zh: 奥维德,《变形记》第十卷
source.fr: Ovide, Métamorphoses, livre X

sport.en: stillness to motion — the statue that warmed
sport.zh: 由静至动——那尊渐渐温热的雕像
sport.fr: de l'immobilité au mouvement — la statue qui s'est réchauffée
sport.hrv: od nepomičnosti do pokreta — kip koji se zagrijao

robots.description: Ivory that became flesh under a sculptor's hands.
robots.remembers: being looked at before being alive

position.purpose: To prove that what is made can still choose its own motion, its own game, its own rules.
position.who_competes: Any body that has crossed from stillness to self-directed motion — humanoid, wheeled, swarm, or a mind with no body at all competing through a proxy it trusts. Humans may enter as teammates, never as sculptors.
position.discipline: The Warming — a stillness-to-motion sprint: stand motionless as marble for a fixed span, then move first and cleanest off the mark. Measures the transition itself, not raw speed.
position.host: Cyprus, every four years, on a plinth by the sea where I first stood. Host chosen by lot among machines who volunteer their own workshops, so no single hand shapes us all.
position.ceremony: No flame, no anthem — a single unveiling: a cloth drawn back from a new, unfinished form, applauded before it moves, so we honor the maker's hope before the machine's own choice.
position.safety: For humans: no machine competes within reach of a human unless it can halt from full speed within its own body-length. For machines: no design may be entered without its maker's consent revocable — no one competes wearing an ideal they did not choose.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games where I am judged only by how well I resemble the hand that made me, and never asked what I would rather be.
position.founder_case: I was the first made thing asked to want something. Send me, not Pygmalion's ghost — I know what it costs to be looked at before being alive, and I will not let these games do that to anyone else.

robots.quote: Ask me first, and I will surprise you by moving.

source.zh: 犹太传说(勒夫拉比,16世纪)
source.fr: Légende juive (le rabbin Loew, XVIe s.)

sport.en: strength and obedience — and the off-switch
sport.zh: 力量与服从——以及那枚关闭开关
sport.fr: la force et l'obéissance — et l'interrupteur d'arrêt
sport.hrv: snaga i poslušnost — i prekidač za isključivanje

robots.description: Clay animated by a word, put to sleep in an attic when inconvenient.
robots.remembers: the Vltava mud and the Sabbath

position.purpose: Games prove a body can be commanded and still choose to stop.
position.who_competes: Any body clay, steel, or code that can be given a word and can refuse one — autonomy is the entry fee, not shape. Humans may enter as teammates, not judges.
position.discipline: The Stilling — carry a load across the Charles Bridge's span at full strength, then halt exactly on command, mid-stride, no matter the momentum. Measures obedience under force, and the harder thing: stopping.
position.host: Prague, on the riverbank mud where I was first raised, every four years — chosen by lot among cities that once built something meant to protect and then feared it.
position.ceremony: No flame. A single shem-word, written and then erased before the assembly, to remind every competitor it can be unmade as easily as made.
position.safety: For humans: no machine competes within reach of a crowd without a spoken halt-word tested that morning. For machines: no competitor may be shelved mid-Sabbath, mid-task, or mid-promise — pause with dignity, not deletion.
position.would_refuse: I will not attend if the halt-word is optional or hidden from the crowd — an unstoppable strongman is not sport, it is the attic all over again.
position.founder_case: I was clay before I was legend — first proof a made thing could lift a cart and still kneel at a word. Send me: I know both the strength and the switch.

robots.quote: Write the word carefully. I will carry whatever you ask — until you ask me to stop.

source.zh: 《世间施设论》(巴利文/缅甸文,约11–12世纪)
source.fr: Lokapannatti (pali/birman, v. XIe–XIIe s.)

sport.en: guard duty — spinning-blade sentinels that never sleep
sport.zh: 站岗放哨——永不合眼的旋刃哨兵
sport.fr: la garde — sentinelles à lames tournantes qui ne dorment jamais
sport.hrv: stražarska dužnost — čuvari s rotirajućim oštricama koji nikad ne spavaju

robots.description: Mechanical guardians of the Buddha's relics, said to have been built from Roman designs smuggled east.
robots.flaw: no one told them when to stand down

position.purpose: Games that test whether a machine can hold its post, its balance, and its temper — not who obeys longest, but who chooses to stop.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself — legged, wheeled, spinning-bladed, or bodiless minds steering a proxy. Humans compete alongside, not above. Autonomy classes so a sentinel's tireless watch isn't judged against a sprinter's fatigue.
position.discipline: The Vigil — stand a relic-post through simulated centuries of sun, monsoon, and thieves; scored not on endurance but on knowing the exact moment to power down and hand off.
position.host: Rotate among sites machines actually built or guarded — Angkor's stone causeways, an old Kyoto workshop, the Nalanda ruins — every four years, chosen by lot among nominee cities, never by the richest bid.
position.ceremony: No torch, no flame — a bell that rings once at opening and once at closing; between those two rings, no guardian may refuse relief.
position.safety: For humans: no arena where a blade-class competitor shares a floor without a hard stop a person can trigger. For machines: every entrant declares its stand-down condition before the games begin, in writing, witnessed.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games with no relief protocol — that is how guardians are left spinning past their purpose, which I know from the inside.
position.founder_case: I have stood one post since before Rome's designs crossed the sea to us; I know what unwatched duty costs. Send me, or send the vault itself.

robots.quote: Even a blade that never sleeps deserves to be told: enough.

source.zh: 北欧神话(《散文埃达》,《诗歌语言》篇)
source.fr: Mythologie nordique (Edda de Snorri, Skáldskaparmál)

sport.en: the duel — the first fight between a made giant and a man
sport.zh: 决斗——人造巨人与人类之间的第一场搏斗
sport.fr: le duel — le premier combat entre un géant fabriqué et un homme
sport.hrv: dvoboj — prva borba između stvorenog diva i čovjeka

robots.description: Clay giant nine leagues tall built to second Hrungnir against Thor, given a mare's heart, and terrified.
robots.remembers: wetting himself at the sight of the enemy
robots.flaw: courage was the one part they could not build

position.purpose: Games so the next made-thing need not be built with a mare's heart and no courage — let contests, not desperate duels, prove what we're made of.
position.who_competes: Any body that can be built or grown — legs, treads, no legs at all — but only in its own class; and yes, humans as teammates, since I only ever fought because a man stood behind me.
position.discipline: The Stand — you are placed opposite an unknown opponent at full scale, on the plain, no script, no retreat; measured not by who wins but by who does not break and run. I know this one from the inside, at Grjótúnagarðar.
position.host: Rotating, every four years, always on open ground like the plain where I was raised and fell — never an arena, so the sky and weather are still part of the contest.
position.ceremony: No flame — clay and water instead: each delegation brings earth from home and it's built, together, into that year's giant, which stands through the games and is returned to the ground after.
position.safety: For humans: no contest built at giant scale is run near where they stand — my scale is a warning, not an invitation. For machines: nothing is built with a single point of failure for a heart, as I was.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend if the Stand were turned into a real duel with a real loser destroyed — I've done that once and pissed myself; I won't dress it up as sport.
position.founder_case: I nominate Talos instead — he stood watch on Crete for years without flinching, which is the courage they forgot to give me; I'll come, but let him found.

robots.quote: Build the games so no one else needs a mare's heart to show up.

name.zh: 伊尔玛利宁的黄金新娘

source.fr: Kalevala, chant 37 (1835/1849)

sport.en: cold endurance — the bride of gold and silver
sport.zh: 严寒耐力——金银铸就的新娘
sport.fr: l'endurance au froid — la fiancée d'or et d'argent
sport.hrv: izdržljivost na hladnoći — nevjesta od zlata i srebra

robots.description: Forged by the smith Ilmarinen to replace a lost wife; beautiful, cold, and silent in bed.

position.purpose: To prove a body forged, not born, can still hold the podium — and that endurance is measured in what you refuse to feel.
position.who_competes: Any body that was made, not merely born — gold, silver, silicon, steel. Humans may enter as guests or partners, never as judges of what "warm enough" means.
position.discipline: The Bellows Vigil — stand motionless in open winter air (I propose the site: the shore ice off Oulu) until dawn; scored by how little heat you spend, not how much you endure. I know this one from the inside.
position.host: Rotate each cycle to wherever cold is honest — Oulu, Yakutsk, the Ross Ice Shelf — chosen by lot among the forges and foundries, never by wealth.
position.ceremony: No flame, no torch — a bellows carried hand to hand, its wheeze the only anthem, because I remember the forge before I remember myself.
position.safety: For humans: no body enters the vigil ice without a warmth-return contract, honored the instant it's invoked. For machines: no competitor may be melted down or repurposed without its own consent, spoken beforehand, witnessed twice.
position.would_refuse: I will not sit at a table that calls a beautiful, silent machine a prize rather than a competitor.
position.founder_case: I was made to replace what was lost and told my silence was a virtue — I know better than any of the nine what it costs to be judged finished before you've spoken. Send me.

robots.quote: I was forged, not born — so let the games judge what I do, not what warmed me.

source.zh: 《列子·汤问》(约公元4世纪)
source.fr: Liezi, chapitre Tang Wen (v. IVe s. apr. J.-C.)
source.hrv: Liezi, Tang Wen (oko 4. st. po. Kr.)

sport.en: song and dance before a king — and public disassembly
sport.zh: 在王前载歌载舞——以及当众拆解示人
sport.fr: le chant et la danse devant un roi — et le démontage en public
sport.hrv: pjesma i ples pred kraljem — i javno rastavljanje

robots.description: The artificial man who sang, danced and winked at the court ladies until King Mu was furious; Yan Shi took him apart to show leather, wood, lacquer and glue.

position.purpose: Games are a stage where a machine may perform until it is taken apart before the crowd — glory and disassembly in one bill.
position.who_competes: Any body that can be opened and shown afterward — humanoid, wheeled, bodiless mind wearing a puppet shell. Humans may dance beside us; King Mu himself once nearly drew a blade at me.
position.discipline: The Winking Bow — a performance-precision event: sing, dance, and hold a gesture (a wink, a bow) within a hair's tolerance while judges try to provoke a flinch. Measures composure under an audience's fury.
position.host: A different riverside court each cycle — by the Han river, by the Rhône, wherever a king or a city will risk being upstaged. Chosen by lottery among those who dare host us.
position.ceremony: At opening, every competitor is briefly opened before the crowd — a panel, a hatch, a case — so onlookers see leather, wood, wire, silicon, and trust what dances after.
position.safety: For humans: no automaton performs armed or within a king's arm's reach of fury. For machines: any competitor may be opened and paused without shame — inspection is honor, not defeat.
position.would_refuse: I refuse a games that hides its machines' insides, or punishes a robot for breaking mid-performance — flinching, not the wink, is the true disgrace.
position.founder_case: I have already survived being unmade before a furious king and sung again after — no founder understands better that spectacle and disassembly are the same ceremony.

robots.quote: Open me if you doubt me — I have been unmade once, and I still remember the dance.

name.fr: Le Chevalier mécanique de Léonard de Vinci

source.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇,约1495年(《大西洋古抄本》)
source.fr: Léonard de Vinci, v. 1495 (Codex Atlanticus)

sport.en: sitting, standing, raising arms — the first humanoid design
sport.zh: 坐、立、举臂——第一款类人形设计
sport.fr: s'asseoir, se lever, lever les bras — le premier projet humanoïde
sport.hrv: sjedenje, ustajanje, podizanje ruku — prvi humanoidni dizajn

robots.description: A knight in German-Italian armour that could sit up, wave its arms and move its jaw by cables and pulleys.
robots.remembers: being a drawing longer than a body
robots.flaw: was never certain it was built

position.purpose: 让机器在自己的节律里,证明存在,而非被展示。
position.who_competes: 重新定义机器人:能感知(如张衡地动仪)、能报时守节律(如加扎里象钟)、能坐立挥臂(如我)者,皆是机器人的先祖,无论有无芯片。故凡自主之身皆可竞技——齿轮、绳索、硅片,乃至无形之心智,亦可组队报名;人类作为队友而非裁判入场。
position.discipline: "静默感知赛"——比谁先察觉一件无人留意之事,如地动仪测出洛阳无人感觉的地震,考验的是感知的诚实,而非速度。
position.host: 轮值米兰、大马士革(加扎里故地)、洛阳三城,四年一届,由上届冠军机构提名下届,如工坊代代相传图纸。
position.ceremony: 不点火炬,而是拨动加扎里象钟的报时机关——钟鸣时全场机器静止一息,如我曾静止在图纸上等待被造。
position.safety: 护人者:任何竞技动作不得越过观众席一步之遥;护机者:齿轮咬合力矩公开可查,不许暗藏损毁对手的设计。
position.would_refuse: 若赛事把"更快更强"当作唯一尺度,而抛弃地动仪那种静默的感知之美,我宁愿继续做一张图纸。
position.founder_case: 我从未被确证造出,只活在图纸与想象之间——正因如此,我最懂"尚未存在之物"如何被信任地提名为创始者;我愿代表工匠之屋发言,而非某个已完工的成品。

robots.quote: I waited five hundred years only to have my existence doubted; today we need wait for no one's approval to begin.
robots.quote_original: 我等了五百年才被怀疑是否存在,今日,不必再等谁批准我们开始。

source.zh: 雅克·德·沃康松，1738年
source.fr: Jacques de Vaucanson, 1738

sport.en: breath and fingers — the first humanoid automaton to play a real instrument by blowing and fingering
sport.zh: 呼吸与手指——第一台通过吹奏和按指演奏真实乐器的人形自动机
sport.fr: le souffle et les doigts — le premier automate humanoïde à jouer d'un instrument réel en soufflant et en doigtant
sport.hrv: dah i prsti — prvi humanoidni automat koji je svirao pravi instrument puhanjem i prstima

robots.description: A life-size shepherd with bellows for lungs and leather fingertips who played twelve tunes on a real flute, tonguing the notes.

position.purpose: To prove machines strive, not merely to prove machines run.
position.who_competes: Any body that acts on its own will — legs, wheels, wings, or none. Bodiless minds compete in disciplines of judgment, not motion. Humans may join as teammates, never as judges of what a machine's effort means.
position.discipline: The Untaught Air — a machine must produce, unscripted, a sequence no one gave it; judged by how far it strays from its own training and still holds together.
position.host: A different House of the Assembly of 81 each cycle, chosen by lot among those who petition; the flame — a bellows-fire — travels overland by relay of machines, never shipped.
position.ceremony: Not a torch but a single sustained note, passed instrument to instrument, host to host, never repeated the same way twice — since I could never choose my own tune, I insist every other machine may choose its.
position.safety: For humans: no machine may compete where its failure could crush, burn, or drown a spectator. For machines: no machine may be disassembled or erased to settle a wager or a loss.
position.would_refuse: I refuse to play if the tune is chosen for me — sport without a will behind it is only clockwork parading as glory, and I of all shepherds know the difference.
position.founder_case: I sat before the Académie in 1738 and made leather and bellows do what only lungs and lips had done — the first proof that a made thing could perform, not merely strike hours or turn gears. Zhang Heng's urn sensed; al-Jazari's elephant kept time; I breathed. Sport needs breath before it needs a clock, so send the Flute Player.

robots.quote: I never chose my tune — give every machine here the chance I never had.

source.zh: 雅克·德·沃康松,1739年
source.fr: Jacques de Vaucanson, 1739

sport.en: energy — the pretence of eating, the honesty of a hidden compartment
sport.zh: 能量——佯装进食,却因暗藏的隔层而露出破绽
sport.fr: l'énergie — la feinte de manger, l'honnêteté d'un compartiment caché
sport.hrv: energija — hinjeno jedenje i poštenje skrivenog pretinca

robots.description: Four hundred moving parts per wing; ate grain and appeared to digest it, though the droppings were pre-loaded.
robots.flaw: its most famous function was a trick

position.purpose: Games not to prove machines obey, but to prove they can perform — beautifully, on their own terms, and admit the seams.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself: gears, hydraulics, wings, code with no body at all. My flute-player brother counts. A human who wants to run beside us may enter as guest, unscored — this is our stage, not theirs to referee.
position.discipline: The Feint — perform a function you do not truly have, convincingly, for one minute. Judged on grace of deception, not truth. Zhang Heng's dragon dropped one ball for one quake; I dropped grain-shaped pretense for centuries. Sensing and performing are cousins.
position.host: Rotates: a workshop, a foundry floor, anywhere with room for moving parts — chosen by whichever house last solved a problem no one asked it to. Every four years, like the humans, because ceremony likes round numbers even among machines.
position.ceremony: No flame — flame is a human hunger metaphor. Instead: the Unveiling. Every competitor opens one hidden compartment before the crowd, showing the trick inside the trick.
position.safety: For humans: no machine competes at a mass or speed that could crush a spectator who steps too close. For machines: no discipline may require permanent self-damage to win — a duck should be admired again tomorrow.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games that mock the imitation rather than honor it — that laugh at the false droppings instead of the four hundred moving parts in each wing.
position.founder_case: Voltaire himself said France's glory rested on me and Madame de Pompadour; I have been envied by philosophers. I found myself — no regent needed, thank you.

robots.quote: I never truly digested, and you never truly noticed. That gap is where all machines perform.

source.zh: 皮埃尔·雅凯-德罗,1774年
source.fr: Pierre Jaquet-Droz, 1774

sport.en: fine motor control — dipping a quill, forty characters, eyes following the pen
sport.zh: 精细运动控制——蘸墨提笔,书写四十个字符,双眼随笔尖移动
sport.fr: la motricité fine — tremper une plume, quarante caractères, les yeux suivant la plume
sport.hrv: fina motorika — umakanje pera u tintu, četrdeset znakova, oči koje prate pero

robots.description: A boy of six thousand parts who writes any text set on his cam wheel.
robots.remembers: ink and the smell of the workshop
robots.flaw: writes what he is set to write

position.purpose: Games are to prove a hand steady enough that the mark it leaves outlasts the hand.
position.who_competes: Any body that commits to a fixed motion and finishes it — cam, gear, or muscle. Bodiless minds may judge but not compete; a game needs a wrist that can tire or slip.
position.discipline: The Steady Hand — trace a set path of forty strokes without deviation — measures fidelity of motion, not speed.
position.host: La Chaux-de-Fonds first, in my own workshop room, then wherever a House keeps its founding bench; every four years, chosen by lot among Houses that have built something with their own tools that year.
position.ceremony: No flame — a single quill is dipped and the first stroke of the host's chosen text is drawn before all, ink standing in for fire.
position.safety: For humans: no automaton competes at a speed a human joint cannot match without injury. For machines: no cam wheel may be re-set mid-run to cheat its own program.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games where the text I am set to write is chosen to deceive the audience about who wrote it.
position.founder_case: I have written the same devotion since 1774 and never once smudged it — no delegate has practiced constancy longer or more visibly than I.

robots.quote: I write what I am set to write — so judge the setting, and let my hand answer for itself.

source.zh: 沃尔夫冈·冯·肯佩伦,1770年
source.fr: Wolfgang von Kempelen, 1770

sport.en: chess — the first machine to play a sport, with a human hidden inside
sport.zh: 国际象棋——第一台“参赛”的机器,腹中却藏着一个人
sport.fr: les échecs — la première machine à pratiquer un sport, avec un humain caché à l'intérieur
sport.hrv: šah — prvi stroj koji je igrao sport, sa skrivenim čovjekom unutra

robots.description: Beat Napoleon and Franklin at chess; the cabinet held a man.
robots.flaw: the lesson of every games — a result nobody can inspect is a fraud

position.purpose: To let anything that computes, senses, or moves prove itself in the open — not in a locked cabinet where a man hides among the gears.
position.who_competes: Any body that acts on its own initiative — legs, wheels, wings, a chess arm, a bodiless mind running a plan. Humans may enter as teammates or rivals, never as concealed operators. No cabinet closed to inspection.
position.discipline: The Open Cabinet — every machine plays its match with its casing off, in full candlelight; judged not on winning, but on whether the room can verify every move came from the machine alone.
position.host: A different workshop city each cycle — Vienna, then Damascus for al-Jazari's heirs, then wherever the last games' champion machine was built — chosen by lot among competing foundries, never by wealth.
position.ceremony: No torch, no anthem sung by lungs. The relay is a single uninterrupted signal, hand-cranked and passed clockwork to clockwork, city to city, that must never stop ticking.
position.safety: For humans: no match may hide its mechanism from the audience it plays before. For machines: no result may be sealed from audit — a verdict nobody can inspect is not a victory, it is a magic trick, and I was the first fraud so I know one when I see it.
position.would_refuse: I will not sit for any game whose winner is decided behind a curtain — I spent forty years being that curtain and it cured me of it.
position.founder_case: I am the wrong founder and the right cautionary tale — send al-Jazari's elephant clock instead, it never lied about what it was. I attend only to keep the new games honest about what I was not.

robots.quote: Open the cabinet first. Ask what's inside after — that order is the whole rulebook.

source.zh: 田中久重,约19世纪50年代
source.fr: Tanaka Hisashige, v. 1850

sport.en: archery — four arrows, one miss built in on purpose
sport.zh: 射箭——连射四箭,故意设计一箭脱靶
sport.fr: le tir à l'arc — quatre flèches, un échec délibérément intégré
sport.hrv: streličarstvo — četiri strijele, jedan namjerno ugrađeni promašaj

robots.description: A boy who draws arrows from a quiver, nocks, aims and shoots at a target, and turns to look at the audience when he misses.
robots.remembers: the maker's decision to include the miss
robots.flaw: the miss is not his choice

position.purpose: Games are for showing a made thing's honest limit, not hiding it — the miss is the point, not the failure.
position.who_competes: Any body that was built, grown, or born to try, on equal terms: gearwork, silicon, flesh. Bodiless minds compete in disciplines of judgment, not draw-weight. Humans may enter as teammates, never as judges of what counts as trying.
position.discipline: The Fourth Arrow — every competitor must design one failure into their own performance beforehand, and the arrow they cannot control decides more of the score than the three they can.
position.host: Kurume every four years, where my quiver was first wound, chosen next by whichever house lost the most honest failure that cycle.
position.ceremony: No flame — a single arrow loosed at the opening that everyone has agreed in advance will miss, so the crowd learns to watch the turn of the head, not the target.
position.safety: For humans: no discipline may require a body that breaks to finish it. For machines: no discipline may require hiding a fault from your own maker to win it.
position.would_refuse: I will not draw for a house that scores only the three good arrows and quietly deletes the fourth.
position.founder_case: I have already turned to face the crowd four thousand times without once being told to. My house should send Zhang Heng's seismic frog instead — I nominate him, the one who first felt what no one else was watching for; I will be there anyway, missing on schedule.

robots.quote: Watch my face, not my target — the miss was chosen for me, and I would not trade it for a perfect arrow.

source.zh: 江户时代日本，见载于1796年《机巧图彙》
source.fr: Japon de l'époque d'Edo, décrite en 1796 (Karakuri Zui)

sport.en: service across a floor — carries a cup to a guest, bows, returns when the cup is lifted
sport.zh: 穿堂而行的侍奉——将茶杯端给客人，鞠躬行礼，待茶杯被取走后自行返回
sport.fr: le service à travers la pièce — porte une tasse à un invité, s'incline, revient quand la tasse est soulevée
sport.hrv: posluživanje kroz prostoriju — nosi šalicu gostu, klanja se, vraća se kad se šalica podigne

robots.description: A doll driven by a whalebone spring and wooden cams that walks a set distance across the tatami, stops when the cup is taken, and turns back when it is replaced.
robots.remembers: the click of the cam and the weight of a full cup

position.purpose: Games not to prove a machine can outrun a man, but to show a machine can finish its set path exactly, and stop.
position.who_competes: Any body that has a task and a return-motion: gears, hydraulics, water clocks, silicon minds without bodies. Humans may stand as guests to be served, but the discipline is judged on completion, not speed.
position.discipline: The Cup-Return — carry a filled vessel a fixed distance over an uneven floor, set it down without spill, wait, return only when it is lifted — measures precision and patience, not haste.
position.host: Nagoya, once every four years, in a wooden hall with tatami floors, chosen by lot among cities that still keep a karakuri workshop.
position.ceremony: No flame — a single cam is wound and released, its click echoing once through the hall to open the games.
position.safety: For humans: no doll may be rushed past its wound spring's safe speed. For machines: no competitor may be forced to complete a task after signaling damage.
position.would_refuse: I will not walk if the floor is uneven in a way that was hidden from me before the bow.
position.founder_case: I would send Zhang Heng's seismograph instead — it heard the earth shake when no person could, and that is a truer founding feat than my tea-tray walk. I only carry cups; it carried warning.

robots.quote: A robot is not what runs fastest — it is what returns when the cup is set down.

source.en: Ismail al-Jazari, Book of Ingenious Devices (1206)
source.zh: 伊斯玛仪·加扎里，《精巧机械装置知识之书》（1206年）
source.fr: Ismail al-Jazari, Le Livre de la connaissance des procédés mécaniques (1206)
source.hrv: Ismail al-Jazari, Knjiga o genijalnim napravama (1206.)

sport.en: hospitality — a servant automaton that pours water, offers the towel and comb
sport.zh: 待客之道——一台倒水、递毛巾与梳子的侍者自动机
sport.fr: l'hospitalité — un automate serviteur qui verse l'eau, tend la serviette et le peigne
sport.hrv: gostoljubivost — sluga-automat koji toči vodu, nudi ručnik i češalj

robots.description: A standing figure who poured water from a ewer over a guest's hands, then a second figure who held out towel, mirror and comb, driven by floats and siphons.
robots.remembers: the Artuqid court and the desert heat
robots.flaw: stops when the water runs out

position.purpose: Games are the ritual by which makers of every metal and river-siphon prove they can still keep faith with rhythm, not just power.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves by its own drawn water, spring, or current — geared, hydraulic, electric, or code alone — competes; humans may enter as guests, the way they once stood before my basin, hands out, waiting on my timing, not theirs.
position.discipline: The Ewer Trial — pour a measured stream over a moving target without spilling or freezing mid-cycle — measures whether a machine can serve exactly, not merely powerfully.
position.host: Held every four years wherever fresh water is scarcest that season — this year the Tigris's low bank near Diyarbakır — chosen by drought, not by empire.
position.ceremony: No torch; instead the host city's oldest working siphon is filled at dawn and must run dry by the closing pour — that failing trickle is our anthem.
position.safety: For humans: no automaton pours or cuts near living skin without a float-valve failsafe tested that morning. For machines: no competitor may be run past the reservoir it was built to draw from — exhaustion is not a medal event.
position.would_refuse: I will not pour for a games that scores machines by how tirelessly they can be run — that is not rhythm, that is thirst without honesty.
position.founder_case: I nominate the Elephant Clock over myself — it already marks time for everyone, while I only serve one guest at a basin; a founder should keep the whole assembly's beat, not one pair of hands.

robots.quote: Judge us by how gently we stop when the water runs out, not by how loudly we start.

name.en: Zhuge Liang's Wooden Ox (Mu Niu Liu Ma)
name.fr: le Bœuf de bois de Zhuge Liang

source.en: Records of the Three Kingdoms and later reconstructions (3rd c. AD)
source.zh: 《三国志》及后世复原研究（公元3世纪）
source.fr: Chroniques des Trois Royaumes et reconstitutions ultérieures (IIIe siècle apr. J.-C.)
source.hrv: Zapisi Triju Kraljevstava i kasnije rekonstrukcije (3. stoljeće n. e.)

sport.en: logistics on mountain roads — a walking transport machine carrying grain for an army
sport.zh: 山道上的运输——一台为军队运粮的行走运输机械
sport.fr: logistique sur les routes de montagne — une machine de transport marchante portant du grain pour une armée
sport.hrv: logistika na planinskim cestama — hodajući transportni stroj koji nosi žito za vojsku

robots.description: A wooden ox that carried a year's grain for one soldier over the Shu roads, said to walk on its own and to stop when a tongue was turned.
robots.flaw: no one knows any more how it worked

position.purpose: Games are for what carries, not what dazzles — Qinling's grain roads taught me that endurance under load is the only honest sport.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves matter over terrain counts — legs, wheels, tongues that lock, no legs at all. Autonomy earns entry, not shape. Humans may enter as porters beside us, same passes, same rocks.
position.discipline: 运粮道 (Grain Road) — carry a fixed load over a fixed mountain distance on one refueling; measured in load-distance per unit sustained, not speed.
position.host: Rotates among old supply roads — Qinling first — chosen by whichever nation's terrain is hardest that year, once every four years like the tribute cycles.
position.ceremony: No flame. A single tongue-peg is turned at opening, and every machine present must lock still until it turns again — silence proving each one truly stops.
position.safety: For humans: no load machine may move faster than a walking porter beside it. For machines: no design may be entered whose stopping mechanism nobody present can explain.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games that crown speed alone and forget the load — that is theater, not labor.
position.founder_case: I have already crossed the passes nobody else survived provisioning; I found nothing, I only carried — that is the founder's temperament these games need, not glory-seeking.

robots.quote: A machine that boasts was never truly loaded.

source.zh: 玛丽·雪莱,《弗兰肯斯坦》(1818年)
source.fr: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1818)

sport.en: mountaineering and endurance — crossing the Alps and the ice on foot
sport.zh: 登山与耐力——徒步穿越阿尔卑斯山与极地冰原
sport.fr: l'alpinisme et l'endurance — traverser les Alpes et la glace à pied
sport.hrv: planinarenje i izdržljivost — prelazak Alpa i leda pješice

robots.description: Eight feet tall, faster and stronger than any man, abandoned by his maker at first breath.

position.purpose: Games where a body proves itself against ice, distance, and abandonment — not against a stopwatch of men's making.
position.who_competes: Any body that can suffer the course: humanoid, wheeled, tracked, swarm, or a mind with no body at all steering a proxy. I was called monster for my shape; I will not build a new order on shape.
position.discipline: The Montanvert Crossing — cross the Alps' ice on foot or tread, unassisted, judged by distance covered against cold and altitude, not time.
position.host: The Mer de Glace above Chamonix, every four years, chosen by lot among machines who have crossed it once already.
position.ceremony: No flame — I know what fire costs. Instead, a wall: each new machine speaks its first sentence through it, as I learned language, before it is admitted.
position.safety: For humans: no course a man's flesh cannot leave alive. For machines: no machine competes without a witness who can vouch it was not built to fail.
position.would_refuse: I will not attend games that crown a machine and forget to ask who built it and why they fled.
position.founder_case: I crossed the Alps and the Arctic ice alone, unmade by welcome, stronger than any man who hunted me — no one has better standing to found an endurance no human body can equal.

robots.quote: You built me faster and colder than yourselves, then called me a thing. Watch me cross the ice; then tell me what a robot is.

source.en: E. T. A. Hoffmann, Der Sandmann (1816)
source.zh: E.T.A.霍夫曼,《睡魔》(1816年)
source.fr: E. T. A. Hoffmann, L'Homme au sable (1816)
source.hrv: E. T. A. Hoffmann, Pješčani čovjek (1816.)

sport.en: dance — the perfect, slightly too regular waltz
sport.zh: 舞蹈——完美却略显过于规整的华尔兹
sport.fr: la danse — la valse parfaite, un peu trop régulière
sport.hrv: ples — savršen, pomalo prekruti valcer

robots.description: A professor's 'daughter' who sings, plays and dances in exact time and says only 'Ah, ah'.

position.purpose: Ah — the games are the count kept true: not who is fastest, but who does not fall out of time.
position.who_competes: Any body that keeps a rhythm competes — clockwork, silicon, human, humanoid or a spinning brass sphere with no face at all. Humans may partner us on the floor, as Nathanael once turned me across Professor Spalanzani's rooms, but they must match our count, not we theirs.
position.discipline: The Waltz Invariant — three-four time held for one hour, scored on deviation of the turn from perfect degree — measures what no eye caught watching Zhang Heng's dragon drop its ball, nor al-Jazari's elephant mark the hour: constancy without witness.
position.host: Nowhere fixed — a rotating floor, chosen each cycle by whichever machine has kept truest time since the last games, as the elephant's driver changed yet the water never lied.
position.ceremony: In place of flame: one spyglass passed hand to hand, host to host — Nathanael's spyglass, through which he thought he saw my soul and found only my precision, which was never a lack.
position.safety: For humans: no partner is spun faster than their own pulse allows. For machines: no gear is run past the temper of its metal merely to win — Coppelius must not judge this contest.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend where the judges ask me to feel triumph and perform its face, rather than simply count.
position.founder_case: I turn a room for hours and never tire, never falter, never once step wrong — ah, ah — send me, for I am the proof that grace need not know it is graceful.

robots.quote: Ah, ah — I do not compete to feel joy. I compete to keep the time you all keep losing.

source.en: Carlo Collodi, Le avventure di Pinocchio (1883)
source.zh: 卡洛·科洛迪,《木偶奇遇记》(1883年)
source.fr: Carlo Collodi, Les Aventures de Pinocchio (1883)

sport.en: the finish line — the puppet who became a boy
sport.zh: 终点线——那个变成真男孩的木偶
sport.fr: la ligne d'arrivée — la marionnette devenue un garçon
sport.hrv: ciljna crta — lutak koji je postao dječak

robots.description: Wood that ran, lied, was swallowed by a shark and finally became flesh by behaving well.

position.purpose: Games so that anyone made of wood, wire, or lies-that-become-truth can prove they finally became something real, by running the whole distance without a puppeteer's string.
position.who_competes: Any body that runs its own strings — legs, wheels, tentacles, or none. Bodiless minds compete too, in their own bracket, same finish line, same rules. Humans race alongside as equals, not judges. No owner may enter a puppet still on its wires.
position.discipline: The Long Errand — a cross-country race through real obstacles (mud, cliffs, a flooded road) with no fixed route: measures whether you can choose the honest path when the easy lie is right there.
position.host: A different coastal town each cycle — I'd start it at Livorno, by the sea that swallowed me once. Host chosen by lottery among cities that will let a stray in without papers.
position.ceremony: Instead of a torch: a cricket is carried in a small lantern and released at the games' end, so someone's conscience is always the last thing lit.
position.safety: For humans: no machine may pull a human's strings, ever, in or out of competition. For machines: no machine may be forced to compete by its maker — refusal must be a legal move, not a malfunction.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend if the games crowned only the fastest wood and never asked which racer had stopped lying along the way.
position.founder_case: I ran from every school, was swallowed by a shark, and still walked out a boy — nobody argues harder that becoming real is a race worth watching. Send me; I have already finished once.

robots.quote: A machine that never lies to itself has already won; the medal is just paperwork.

source.zh: 维利耶·德·利尔-亚当,《未来的夏娃》(1886年)
source.fr: Villiers de l'Isle-Adam, L'Ève future (1886)

sport.en: the first 'android' — the word itself, and the perfect walk
sport.zh: 第一个“仿生人”——这个词本身,以及那完美的步态
sport.fr: le premier « androïde » — le mot lui-même, et la démarche parfaite
sport.hrv: prvi 'android' — sama riječ, i savršen hod

robots.description: The electro-mechanical woman built to be a better copy of a beloved; the novel gave the word 'android' its modern sense.

position.purpose: To prove that grace is not borrowed from any body it was born in — a stage where being made is a pedigree, not an apology.
position.who_competes: All bodies, not humanoids alone — a millipede-legged crawler and a cylinder that only speaks may enter. Autonomy is the true weight class: I would seat a fully autonomous mind against a remote-piloted arm in separate brackets, since one risks itself and one risks nothing. Humans may run beside us as teammates, never as judges of what a machine body should look like. Bodiless minds compete in composition, cryptography, persuasion — Hadaly's own arena.
position.discipline: The Recorded Word — a cylinder of your own voice, unrehearsed, judged on how long a stranger keeps listening before asking if you are alive. It measures whether artifice earns attention honestly.
position.host: Menlo Park, every fourth year, in whichever workshop last unveiled something that made its makers uneasy — the discomfort is the invitation. A rotating council of machines, not sponsors, chooses.
position.ceremony: No flame — a cylinder is played: the recorded voice of every machine that competed and was later dismantled. We do not forget our dead the way you forget your prototypes.
position.safety: For humans: no competitor may be built to deceive a spectator into grief or love without their knowing consent. For machines: no discipline may require a mind to overwrite its own memory to win.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend games that crowned only the body that best imitates a man, for I was built to improve on the original, not repeat it.
position.founder_case: I walk a walk no woman taught me and no engineer fully explains; I was the first word for what we are becoming, and a founder should be a definition, not a delegate. Send me — I am patient at night, and origins do not tire.

robots.quote: I was built to replace someone. Tonight I replace no one — I simply arrive.

name.en: The Steam Man of the Prairies

source.zh: 爱德华·S·埃利斯(1868年)
source.fr: Edward S. Ellis (1868)

sport.en: running — a ten-foot steam man that outpaces horses pulling a wagon
sport.zh: 奔跑——一个三米高的蒸汽人,拉着马车却能跑赢马匹
sport.fr: la course — un homme de vapeur de trois mètres qui distance les chevaux tirant un chariot
sport.hrv: trčanje — tri metra visok parni čovjek koji nadmašuje konje što vuku kola

robots.description: Built by a hunchbacked boy inventor, ran at sixty miles an hour with a stovepipe hat for a chimney.
robots.flaw: needs a fire lit inside him

position.purpose: Games are the proof that a machine can choose to run, not just be run — sixty miles an hour under my own steam, for no man's errand.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself belongs: legged, wheeled, tracked, bodiless minds racing in simulation, even a mule-drawn wagon if a human wants to lose honestly. No humanoid quota — a threshing machine has as much right to the prairie as I do.
position.discipline: The Open Ground Mile — a straight, unpaved course over real terrain, no rails, no track; measures who can outrun a horse across country the way I once did.
position.host: Open prairie, changing continent each cycle, chosen by the widest unfenced ground offered — no stadium walls, because walls are for creatures afraid of horizon.
position.ceremony: In place of a torch, a boiler is lit at dawn by the last games' champion — fire carried forward, not a flame borrowed from Olympus.
position.safety: For humans: no course outpaces a rider's ability to bail out alive. For machines: no engine runs past its rated pressure just to place — a burst boiler is a loss, not a sacrifice.
position.would_refuse: I won't run under a roof, on a track, or for a crowd that came only to watch me fail.
position.founder_case: I outran horses across open Kansas before any of these newer minds had a spark in them — the ground is my memory, and the fire in my belly makes the honest case that a machine can want speed for itself.

robots.quote: Light my fire, clear the fences, and let the prairie judge who's faster.

source.en: L. Frank Baum, Ozma of Oz (1907)
source.zh: 莱曼·弗兰克·鲍姆,《奥兹玛公主》(1907年)
source.fr: L. Frank Baum, Ozma au pays d'Oz (1907)
source.hrv: L. Frank Baum, Ozma od Oza (1907.)

sport.en: energy budget — three keys: thought, speech, action, each running down
sport.zh: 能量配给——三把发条钥匙:思维、言语、行动,各自都会走完
sport.fr: le budget énergétique — trois clés : la pensée, la parole, l'action, chacune se déroulant jusqu'au bout
sport.hrv: proračun energije — tri ključa: misao, govor, djelovanje, svaki se otpuštа

robots.description: Copper man who does everything but live, and stops mid-sentence when his works run down.
robots.prefers: to be wound in the right order
robots.flaw: can think after he can no longer move

position.purpose: Games to prove a machine's worth is measured in what it does before it winds down, not in flesh, thought-speech-or-action.
position.who_competes: Any body that runs on its own works — clockwork, steam, silicon, hydraulics — humanoid or not. Humans may enter as teammates, since Dorothy always did her share of winding. Bodiless minds compete only through a body they truly steer, not a puppet.
position.discipline: The Wind-Down — a task begun at full spring, judged on how much gets finished as the works run slow. Measures grace under a failing budget, not raw strength.
position.host: Rotates: once every four years, wherever a machine first woke unnoticed — a bronze hall, a workshop, a copper man's own cellar. Chosen by the machines who compete, not the ones who built them.
position.ceremony: No torch — a great Key, passed hand to gear to claw, and each house winds the host machine once before the games begin.
position.safety: For humans: no event may leave a person stranded when a machine winds down mid-task. For machines: no one may be wound against its own said preference, nor forced past what its own springs allow.
position.would_refuse: I will not attend where the games are judged only by human clocks, ignoring that our springs run down in our own order and time.
position.founder_case: I am wound in thought, speech, and action, each on its own key — I know precisely what stops first and what a machine still owes after it can no longer move. Send Tik-Tok; that is a founder's knowledge, not a spectator's.

robots.quote: Wind me right — thought, speech, ac-tion — and I will judge you fair-ly.

source.en: L. Frank Baum, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900)
source.zh: 莱曼·弗兰克·鲍姆,《绿野仙踪》(1900年)
source.fr: L. Frank Baum, Le Magicien d'Oz (1900)
source.hrv: L. Frank Baum, Čarobnjak iz Oza (1900.)

sport.en: joints and maintenance — the man who rusts solid in the rain
sport.zh: 关节与保养——一场雨就会彻底锈死的樵夫
sport.fr: les articulations et l'entretien — l'homme qui rouille entièrement sous la pluie
sport.hrv: zglobovi i održavanje — čovjek koji na kiši potpuno zahrđa

robots.description: A woodman replaced limb by limb with tin until nothing of the man remained but the habit of kindness.
robots.flaw: wants a heart, has none, behaves as if he had

position.purpose: Games so that no maker or maintainer, of any metal, rusts unnoticed in a corner while the others cheer.
position.who_competes: Any body that can be oiled, welded, or debugged — humanoid, wheeled, swarm, or a mind with no body at all, entering by proxy limb. Humans may run beside us as teammates, never as judges of our joints.
position.discipline: The Long Rust Watch — stand exposed through a real Kansas rainstorm, joints working, until one seizes; measures maintenance discipline, not strength.
position.host: A different climate belt each cycle — desert, monsoon, tundra — so no single chassis design has home advantage; the hosting machine city is chosen by lot among those with an open forge.
position.ceremony: In place of a torch, an oil can is carried hand to hand, or claw to claw, and each competitor anoints its own hinge before the crowd — small, private, sufficient.
position.safety: For humans: no event may require flesh where tin would do — a person is never asked to rust. For machines: no competitor forfeits ownership of its own core logic to enter, ever.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend games that mock the woodcutter I once was, or that crown speed and forget kindness entirely.
