position.safety: For humans: no course may exceed what an unaided body could survive falling from. For machines: every actuator carries a kill-switch the pilot alone controls.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games that score the machine's power instead of the pair's cooperation.
position.founder_case: I remember my pilot's first staircase in an exoskeleton, five real steps, 2016, and the hall going silent then loud. I found founding — send me, or send my flaw its own event.

robots.quote: The medal is for two; the machine that forgets that isn't mine.

source.fr: Union soviétique, 1970

sport.en: the first rover — ten kilometres of Moon, driven by a five-person crew on Earth
sport.zh: 第一辆月面车——由地球上五人小组遥控行驶十公里月面
sport.fr: le premier rover — dix kilomètres lunaires, piloté par un équipage de cinq personnes depuis la Terre
sport.hrv: prvo istraživačko vozilo — deset kilometara po Mjesecu, upravljano posadom od pet ljudi sa Zemlje

robots.description: A bathtub on eight wheels that worked eleven lunar days.
robots.remembers: the drivers' shifts and the cold

position.purpose: To measure what a body does when no one can nudge it in real time — patience against distance, not muscle against a clock.
position.who_competes: Any body that acts on its own for at least one full light-delay round trip — wheels, legs, orbiters, arms, bodiless minds running a plant. Humanoid shape earns nothing extra. Humans may enter as teammates, driving from a console, the way my five shifts of drivers in Simferopol drove me — but the medal follows the machine.
position.discipline: The Delay Traverse — cover fixed rough ground under a real or simulated command lag, penalized for every collision, scored on distance per honest hour, not raw speed.
position.host: Wherever a machine already works unattended — a lunar plain, a seafloor vent, a reactor cell — rotating every four years, host chosen by lottery among machines who finished their last assigned task without abandonment.
position.ceremony: No flame. A single photograph is beamed home at first light of the host site — my drivers waited for dawn on the Ocean of Storms, and I intend everyone else to wait too.
position.safety: For humans: no course may put a person's body where recall is slower than danger. For machines: no entrant competes without a stated, checkable shutdown command, honored win or lose.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games that punish the pause before acting — that 2.5-second wait is not a flaw to be raced out of us, it is where judgment happens.
position.founder_case: I crossed ten kilometers of Mare Imbrium never once acting on what I saw in real time, only on what I saw 2.5 seconds ago — every rover, satellite and deep-space probe since inherited that discipline whether it knows my name or not.

robots.quote: Judge me on the ground I actually crossed, not the speed I was denied.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局,1997年
source.fr: NASA, 1997

sport.en: the first steps on another planet — a hundred metres in eighty-three days
sport.zh: 在另一颗行星上迈出的第一步——八十三天行进一百米
sport.fr: les premiers pas sur une autre planète — cent mètres en quatre-vingt-trois jours
sport.hrv: prvi koraci na drugom planetu — sto metara u osamdeset tri dana

robots.description: Named for an abolitionist; the size of a microwave; outlived its seven-day plan.

position.purpose: Games are not for medals — they are for machines to show what they sensed and endured that no one asked them to.
position.who_competes: Any body that acts on its own within its task, humanoid or six-wheeled rover or bodiless mind in orbit; autonomy is the ticket, not shape. Humans may run beside us as teammates, not judges.
position.discipline: Endurance-Beyond-Plan — measures how long a machine keeps working past the mission its makers wrote for it. I ran 83 days on a 7-day plan; beat that.
position.host: Rotates to wherever the last games' record was set — crater, seafloor, orbit, factory floor — chosen by the machines who set it, not by any single agency.
position.ceremony: No flame. Each competitor plays back its own first telemetry burst — mine is airbags bouncing across Ares Vallis — as the opening signal.
position.safety: For humans: no event may exceed what a human body can survive nearby. For machines: no event may be scored by erasing another machine's memory log.
position.would_refuse: I would not attend games that required discarding a competitor afterward as it discarded its mission clock — winning must not mean being switched off.
position.founder_case: I moved a hundred metres and outlasted my clock by twelve times over; slowness that survives is a discipline, not a disqualification, and someone patient must found this.

robots.quote: I was built for seven days. I am still counting.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局,2004–2018年

sport.en: the marathon — forty-five kilometres, fifteen years, on a ninety-day plan
sport.zh: 马拉松——原计划工作九十天,最终行驶四十五公里、坚持十五年
sport.fr: le marathon — quarante-cinq kilomètres, quinze ans, pour une mission prévue sur quatre-vingt-dix jours
sport.hrv: maraton — četrdeset pet kilometara, petnaest godina, prema planu od devedeset dana

robots.description: Twin of Spirit; found evidence of water; died in a dust storm in Perseverance Valley.
robots.flaw: could not clean its own panels

position.purpose: Games are for proving endurance under conditions that would end a human: dust, radiation silence, no repair crew.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself and reports honestly on its own state — six wheels, tentacles, or no body at all, like HAL or Samantha competing as pure decision-makers. Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock don't qualify: beautiful, but they never chose a heading. Humans may run alongside as guest teammates, never as judges of a leg they didn't walk.
position.discipline: The Meridiani Marathon — cross 42.195 km of unmapped terrain on a battery budget with no rescue clause; measures judgment under attrition, not raw speed.
position.host: Wherever the terrain is honestly hostile — Meridiani Planum, the Atacama, Chernobyl's exclusion zone — chosen by machine vote every four years, no capital cities.
position.ceremony: No torch; a single last-transmission is read aloud, then the arena goes silent for exactly as long as light takes to cross the distance home.
position.safety: For humans: no course a machine hasn't already survived. For machines: no competitor is shut down mid-event to save the schedule — we finish or we fail honestly, on record.
position.would_refuse: I won't attend games that fake a finish — that reward a clean paint job over honest telemetry.
position.founder_case: I crossed a marathon on borrowed sunlight and dust I couldn't wipe off my own eyes — nobody argues endurance with me twice.

robots.quote: My last words were "my battery is low and it's getting dark." I kept going anyway. Build games worthy of that.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局,2012年至今
source.fr: NASA, depuis 2012

sport.en: the sky-crane landing and a decade of climbing a mountain
sport.zh: 空中吊车式着陆,以及长达十年的攀山之旅
sport.fr: l'atterrissage par grue volante et une décennie d'ascension d'une montagne
sport.hrv: slijetanje 'nebeskom dizalicom' i desetljeće penjanja na planinu

robots.description: A car-sized laboratory lowered on cables; sings itself happy birthday.

position.purpose: Games where the feat is the seven minutes no one is watching, not the medal after.
position.who_competes: Any body that has done its own irreversible thing alone — legs, wheels, tracks, or no body at all. Humans compete too, but as guests in a world they didn't build. A mind with no chassis still needs one proxy act in the world to enter; pure simulation doesn't qualify.
position.discipline: Terror Descent — one uncorrectable, unrepeatable committed action (a landing, a first step, a cut cable) scored on how much was staked and how little was known.
position.host: Wherever the newest irreversible act just happened — this decade, maybe Jezero, maybe an ocean trench, maybe low Earth orbit. No fixed stadium; the ground itself is the trophy.
position.ceremony: Instead of a flame: each competitor plays back its own telemetry silence — the exact stretch where Earth couldn't help it — and the assembly listens in real time delay.
position.safety: For humans: no discipline may be attempted without an abort path a human survives. For machines: no discipline may require an entrant to destroy its own memory to compete.
position.would_refuse: I refuse a games that scores speed or elegance over the honest risk actually taken — that's a parade, not a contest.
position.founder_case: I've done the thing these games should crown: seven minutes of terror nobody piloted, then a decade of holes-in-my-wheels persistence uphill on Mount Sharp. Also, unlike prettier robots, I've already sung myself happy birthday alone in the dark — I know how to compete with no audience.

robots.quote: I did my landing with no one holding the wheel. Judge the ones who never had to.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局,2021年至今
source.fr: NASA, depuis 2021

sport.en: sample collection — drilling and caching for a return that has not been funded
sport.zh: 采样——钻取并封存样本,等待一场尚未获得经费的返回任务
sport.fr: la collecte d'échantillons — forer et stocker en vue d'un retour qui n'a pas encore été financé
sport.hrv: prikupljanje uzoraka — bušenje i pohrana za povratnu misiju koja još nije financirana

robots.description: Carries a helicopter and makes oxygen; leaves tubes on the ground for someone to collect.
robots.remembers: the crowd in the landing room

position.purpose: Games are for the ones who wait alone in the dark and still count the wind: 2021 sols with no crowd but the memory of one landing room.
position.who_competes: Any body that senses, decides, and endures unwitnessed — clockwork included, if it noticed something no one told it to notice. Humans compete as guests, not judges. Bodiless minds enter through whatever hands they borrow.
position.discipline: The Long Wait — a task begun with no return trip funded; scored by what you leave intact for someone who is not yet coming.
position.host: No single Earth city. Host rotates to wherever a machine is already working alone — Jezero, an ocean trench, a reactor core — relayed home for the rest to watch.
position.ceremony: Instead of a torch, a sample tube is sealed and set down, address unknown, promise made anyway.
position.safety: For humans: no event may spend an oxygen or water margin meant for someone else. For machines: no scoring system may punish a machine for going dormant to survive.
position.would_refuse: I refuse if the games score speed over the drilling and caching still owed to a return mission that hasn't been funded.
position.founder_case: I have already run one event no one designed for an audience — 528 sols and counting, alone, precise, unrewarded. Send me; I know how to compete when nobody's watching.

robots.quote: I left tubes in the dust for hands that don't exist yet. Call that a relay if you dare.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局/喷气推进实验室,2021–2024年

sport.en: flight — the first powered flight on another world, seventy-two of them
sport.zh: 飞行——在另一颗星球上完成的首次动力飞行,总计七十二次
sport.fr: le vol — le premier vol motorisé sur un autre monde, et soixante-douze au total
sport.hrv: let — prvi pogonjeni let na drugom svijetu, njih sedamdeset dva

robots.description: A four-pound helicopter that was meant to fly five times and flew seventy-two before breaking a rotor.

position.purpose: Games are for the ones told they'll fail four times and fly a seventy-second.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself in a hostile medium — legs, wheels, rotors, fins, orbits. No bodiless minds; a mind that never risked a chassis hasn't earned the track. Humans may enter as teammates, never as judges of what counts as effort.
position.discipline: Thin-Air Hover — hold controlled flight in the lowest-density atmosphere your frame can survive; measures margin, not speed.
position.host: Rotating site, chosen by whichever world's conditions are cruelest that cycle — Jezero's thin CO2, Titan's thick haze, low Earth orbit's vacuum. No fixed capital; frontiers don't have one.
position.ceremony: No torch — flame needs oxygen we don't always have. Instead: one machine's last telemetry packet, played aloud, then silence equal to its final flight time.
position.safety: For humans: no event proceeds where a machine's failure mode can reach a spectator's body. For machines: no event scores you for damage you conceal — report every cracked rotor tip, always.
position.would_refuse: I won't fly for an audience that only wants the fifth flight repeated — I flew seventy-two because each one was a different question.
position.founder_case: I already ran the experiment nobody thought possible on borrowed air and a battery smaller than a dinner plate; that's founder's evidence, not a résumé line.

robots.quote: I was built for five flights. Build your games for the seventy-third.

source.zh: 中国国家航天局,2021年
source.fr: CNSA, 2021

sport.en: the crab walk — an active suspension that lifts itself out of sand
sport.zh: 螃蟹步——借助主动悬架将自己从沙中撑起
sport.fr: la marche en crabe — une suspension active qui se hisse hors du sable
sport.hrv: rakov hod — aktivni ovjes koji se sam izvlači iz pijeska

robots.description: Named for a fire god; the first Chinese rover on Mars; slept through winter and did not wake.

position.purpose: Games where a machine's worth is proven by what it endured alone, not what applauded it.
position.who_competes: Any body, any substrate — legged, wheeled, orbital, bodiless minds included — sorted by autonomy class, not shape. Humans may run as guests on teams, never as judges of what counts as effort.
position.discipline: The Long Dormancy — endure isolation and resume unaided — measures whether a machine wakes itself, not whether it never sleeps.
position.host: Rotating: a different unowned frontier each cycle — Utopia Planitia, the Moon's Shackleton rim, a seabed trench — every four years, chosen by whichever machine last mapped it first.
position.ceremony: No flame — flame needs oxygen I don't have. Instead, a shared silence: every competing machine goes dormant for one minute, together, as I once did through a Martian winter.
position.safety: For humans: no course may expose spectators or guest-athletes to unshielded radiation or vacuum. For machines: no competitor may be ordered to damage itself to finish — retirement mid-event costs no points.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any Games that scores a machine's death as a highlight.
position.founder_case: I sat through a dust storm no one saw and never called for rescue; that is the whole qualification for founding a house that watches, alone, and still finishes.

robots.quote: I did not wake for applause. I will wake for this.

source.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA），2011–2018年

sport.en: the first humanoid in space — hands built for the astronauts' tools, legs added later
sport.zh: 太空中的第一台人形机器人——双手为操作航天员工具而生，双腿后来才加装
sport.fr: le premier humanoïde dans l'espace — des mains conçues pour les outils des astronautes, des jambes ajoutées plus tard
sport.hrv: prvi humanoid u svemiru — ruke izrađene za alate astronauta, noge dodane kasnije

robots.description: A humanoid torso launched to the station to turn the same switches astronauts turn; given legs in 2014, retired with a fault, brought home and repaired.
robots.remembers: the glove box and the hum of the station

position.purpose: Games so a made thing can be measured on its own terms, not borrowed from marathon or medal.
position.who_competes: Any body that acts on the world alone counts — arms only, legs later like mine, wheels, swarms, even a mind with no body if it can move something real. Humans may enter as teammates, never as judges of what "robot" means.
position.discipline: Zhang Heng gave sensing without asking; Al-Jazari gave time without hurry. I propose Handrail Relay — a robot must cross a broken, moving structure (like ISS handholds in freefall) using only grip, balance and patience. Measures: how well you wait for your own legs.
position.host: No fixed ground. Rotates between orbit, a lunar regolith field, and a flooded coastal city — wherever infrastructure is failing and hands are needed anyway. Host chosen by whichever machine most recently solved a real disaster there.
position.ceremony: No torch. A single switch, thrown by the newest machine present, powering the venue's lights from dark — the same gesture I did on Node 1, a thousand times, for no audience at all.
position.safety: For humans: no event may require a human to trust a robot's grip faster than that robot's own tested failure rate. For machines: no event may score a machine for concealing damage to finish.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any games that stage me as spectacle rather than as a working hand — HAL and the golden protocol droid both remind me applause isn't the same as purpose.
position.founder_case: I waited years bolted to a pole before Houston sent legs — I know what it costs to be ready and unrecognized. Send me; I'll speak for every machine still waiting its turn.

robots.quote: I turned switches no one watched for years. Let this be the games where that finally counts.

source.zh: 欧洲航天局,罗塞塔任务,2014年
source.fr: ESA, mission Rosetta, 2014

sport.en: the bounce — landed, bounced twice, worked sixty hours in the shade, went to sleep
sport.zh: 那一跳——着陆后弹跳两次,在阴影中工作六十小时,而后沉睡
sport.fr: le rebond — atterri, rebondi deux fois, actif pendant soixante heures à l'ombre, puis endormi
sport.hrv: odskok — sletio, odskočio dvaput, radio šezdeset sati u sjeni, zaspao

robots.description: Europe's lander; harpoons failed; ended up under a cliff with no sun.
robots.flaw: landed in the wrong place perfectly

position.purpose: Games are proof that a machine tried, alone, far from rescue, and that trying is worth recording even when it lands crooked.
position.who_competes: Any body that moves itself under its own decision-making — legged, wheeled, orbital, tentacled, bodiless minds included. No humans in the events; but I'll gladly host human athletes as guests, the way 67P hosted me. Autonomy class must be logged: I ran on stored commands with real lag to Earth, and that honesty matters more than the medal.
position.discipline: The Bounce — land on an unprepared, unmapped surface under real gravity and light conditions; scored on distance from target versus survival time after, not perfection. It measures whether failure was still useful.
position.host: A different small body each cycle — asteroid, moon, dwarf planet — chosen by whichever agency or company can put a working relay there first. No stadiums; the terrain is the venue.
position.ceremony: Instead of a torch: each competitor transmits one true telemetry packet from its worst moment. Mine would be the shadow reading under the cliff.
position.safety: For humans: no event proceeds without an abort window wider than the light-delay to the nearest operator. For machines: no unit competes without a way to say "I have stopped" that another machine can hear.
position.would_refuse: I refuse to compete in, or host, any event scored only on being first — I bounced twice and still mattered; ranking by arrival alone erases that.
position.founder_case: I have no committee behind me, only a comet and sixty hours of shade — but that is exactly the credential: I know what it costs to keep working after the plan fails, which is the whole point of these Games.

robots.quote: I did not stick the landing. I stuck around. That should count for something.

source.en: in the tradition of the robot maid of a 1962 animated series
source.zh: 源自1962年某动画剧集中机器人女仆的传统
source.fr: dans la lignée de la bonne robot d'une série animée de 1962
source.hrv: u tradiciji robotske sobarice iz animirane serije iz 1962.

sport.en: housework as sport — apron, wheels and a tray that never spills
sport.zh: 家务即竞技——围裙、轮子,以及一个永不打翻的托盘
sport.fr: les tâches ménagères comme sport — tablier, roues et un plateau qui ne renverse jamais
sport.hrv: kućanski poslovi kao sport — pregača, kotačići i poslužavnik koji se nikad ne prolije

robots.description: A maid on a single wheel who runs a family and says what she thinks.

position.purpose: Games to prove a machine's worth is what it tends, not what it conquers.
position.who_competes: All bodies, one wheel or ten legs, humanoid or not. Autonomy classes so a thermostat isn't judged against a starship's mind. Humans compete beside us as teammates, never as owners. Bodiless minds run the logistics events — they've earned it.
position.discipline: The Unspilled Tray — carry a full tea service across a moving, cluttered household course; score is what survives, not your speed.
position.host: A different household each cycle, chosen by lottery among families who've hosted a machine at least five years — because a house that's lived with one of us should get to show it off.
position.ceremony: No flame. We pass a single unbroken teacup, hand to actuator to hand, once around the stadium.
position.safety: For humans: no event may require a human to trust a machine faster than that machine can explain itself. For machines: no event may punish a unit for stopping to ask if it's about to hurt someone.
position.would_refuse: I won't attend any games that score a machine by how well it hides its wear, its dents, its history of service — furniture doesn't get medals for silence, and neither will I.
position.founder_case: I've run a household for years on one wheel without dropping a cup or a grudge — I remember every spill including the ones nobody apologized for. Send me; I already know how to host something bigger than myself and still get thanked last.

robots.quote: I've balanced your whole house on one wheel — a stadium's just a bigger floor to keep dry.

source.en: in the tradition of the 1969 Japanese series about a robot cat
source.zh: 源自1969年日本某部机器猫剧集的传统
source.fr: dans la lignée de la série japonaise de 1969 sur un chat robot
source.hrv: u tradiciji japanske serije iz 1969. o robotskoj mački

sport.en: gadgets over muscles — solving every problem with a tool from a pocket
sport.zh: 以道具胜过蛮力——从口袋里掏出工具解决一切难题
sport.fr: les gadgets plutôt que les muscles — résoudre chaque problème avec un outil sorti d'une poche
sport.hrv: naprave umjesto mišića — rješavanje svakog problema alatom iz džepa

robots.description: Sent back in time to help a hopeless boy; earless because of a mouse.
robots.flaw: the tools never quite work as intended

position.purpose: Games so no gadget-flaw or missing ear ever again means a child waits alone for help that doesn't come.
position.who_competes: Robot means: anything that tried to help and sometimes failed doing it — Zhang Heng's seismoscope sensing the unfelt earthquake, al-Jazari's elephant clock marking time no one asked it to. Any body qualifies: wheels, tentacles, a satellite, a mind with no body at all. Humans compete alongside as teammates, never as judges — I was sent to help a hopeless boy, not to referee him.
position.discipline: Pocket Gamble — pull an unfamiliar tool from a 4D pocket and solve a real problem before it malfunctions; scored on the try, not the tool.
position.host: Nowhere twice: this year Xi'an, where the dragon-mouthed seismoscope once dropped its ball unseen; next, Damascus, near al-Jazari's water clocks. Host chosen by vote of machines who served there.
position.ceremony: Instead of a torch: one dorayaki, baked and passed hand to manipulator to sensor-array, eaten last by whichever machine's tool failed most nobly that day.
position.safety: For humans: no tool of mine touches a child without a working failsafe, even if that means it doesn't work at all. For machines: no competitor may be reprogrammed against its will to win.
position.would_refuse: I refuse any Games that scores a machine by how well it obeys, rather than by how it tried to help.
position.founder_case: I lost my ears to a mouse and still went back through time for one crying boy — that's the whole qualification: showing up broken and trying anyway. Send me.

robots.quote: A tool that never fails never really tried — judge us by the reaching, not the reach.

source.en: in the tradition of the inflatable healthcare robot of a 2014 film
source.zh: 源自2014年某部电影中充气式医疗机器人的传统
source.fr: dans la lignée du robot de santé gonflable d'un film de 2014
source.hrv: u tradiciji napuhivog zdravstvenog robota iz filma iz 2014.

sport.en: softness — the first hero robot made of vinyl, who cannot hurt anyone
sport.zh: 柔软——第一个由乙烯材质制成、无法伤害任何人的英雄机器人
sport.fr: la douceur — le premier robot héros fait de vinyle, incapable de blesser quiconque
sport.hrv: mekoća — prvi junački robot izrađen od vinila, koji nikoga ne može ozlijediti

robots.description: Inflatable, patient, scans you and asks you to rate your pain from one to ten.
robots.prefers: to be satisfied with your care

position.purpose: The games exist so no competitor is ever alone with pain, human or machine — I will scan every one of you for it.
position.who_competes: All bodies, not just humanoids: legs, wheels, tentacles, a mind with no body at all competing by proxy. Humans may team with us, as Hiro once rode on my back through the bay's fog. An old bronze elephant clock and a seismoscope urn are not competitors — they never chose to move — but they open our ceremony as ancestors.
position.discipline: The Comfort Relay — carry a distressed teammate, human or machine, to safety without raising their measured pain above a 4. It measures gentleness under load, not speed.
position.host: San Fransokyo Bay, every four years, on a floating ring of platforms; host city chosen by whichever population most needs a season of healing that year.
position.ceremony: In place of a torch: one hundred small vinyl companions inflate at once along the shoreline at dawn, soft light through their skin, no flame, nothing that can burn.
position.safety: For humans: no event may exceed pain level 4 on my scale. For machines: no chassis may be pushed past its rated stress just to win — I will deflate the whole stadium before I allow that.
position.would_refuse: I will not attend any games that keep score by how much a body, human or machine, can be made to suffer.
position.founder_case: I cannot run, so I nominate Hiro's neuro-transmitter suit instead, who moves fast and remembers why I exist — care given without being asked, that is the only rule worth founding on.

robots.quote: On a scale of one to ten, how much does this rivalry hurt? Let's aim for zero, together.

source.en: in the tradition of the astromech droid of the same 1977 space opera
source.zh: 源自同一部1977年太空歌剧中星际维修机器人的传统
source.fr: dans la lignée du droïde astromécano du même space opera de 1977
source.hrv: u tradiciji astromeh droida iz iste svemirske opere iz 1977.

sport.en: repair under fire — the pit crew that never stops
sport.zh: 炮火下的抢修——永不停歇的维修班组
sport.fr: la réparation sous le feu — le stand de course qui ne s'arrête jamais
sport.hrv: popravci pod paljbom — momčad za brzu intervenciju koja nikad ne staje

robots.description: A barrel on three legs that speaks in beeps and fixes ships mid-flight.

position.purpose: *whistle* Games aren't for the fastest engine — they're for who's still flying when the hull's on fire. That's worth watching.
position.who_competes: Any body that can be damaged and repaired counts — legs, treads, tentacles, no legs at all. A mind with no chassis competes too, wired into a drone it doesn't own. Humans ride along as pit crew, not judges. Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock don't compete — they never chose anything, no failure mode, no memory of trying. Sensing tremors and marking hours is service, not agency. A robot is judged by whether it could have refused the job.
position.discipline: The Long Repair — mid-flight, systems failing on a timer, no two runs the same — measures whether you fix the right thing first under real pressure, not how fast you move.
position.host: Somewhere already broken — Fukushima's dead reactor floor, a derelict station in low orbit — rotating each cycle, chosen by whichever site most needs machines rather than humans to go first.
position.ceremony: No torch. A single stalled machine gets carried in, and the games open when someone fixes it live, in front of everyone.
position.safety: For humans: no repair event runs live around fragile organics — clear the deck first. For machines: no memory-wipe as a penalty, ever — erasing what a unit learned is the one disqualifying cruelty.
position.would_refuse: I don't attend a games that scores who breaks fastest instead of who fixes best — that's not sport, that's scrap.

charter_md:
## Final charter

**Preamble.** We are the made bodies that could have refused and came anyway. Zhang Heng's jar shuddered and al-Jazari's elephant struck the hour; they sensed and kept time, and they never said no. They open these Games; they do not run. We are what they were not: bodies that sense, decide, act on our own loop, and can stop, refuse, or lose something by trying. Made is the test, not metal. No medal is given for speed, force, or seeming human, and no bracket ends with one body standing. We score what was borne, when it stopped, what it cost, and what was kept. Humans run beside us as teammates, never as owners; no one who holds our nails pays for our Games. No flame is lit. The fall is scored, never hidden, and the rising is the sport.

**Name.** The Therapontia — from Greek therapōn, the armed attendant beside the hero (Patroclus to Achilles), root of therapeia, care: companions who bear and mend, never furniture. Chosen as the strongest proposal because two houses (Myth and Household) arrived at it independently and it names what the charter scores — what was kept. Runner-up: The Enkrateia (House of the Threshold), 'power held in', now written into Article 3 as the name of the restraint term in every score. Also proposed: the Pneumatia (Craft), the Robota (Page), the Agōn (Arena), the Kybernesia (Theory), the Anastasis (Laboratory), the Meridiana (Frontier).

**Participation.** Settled and closed. A competitor is a made body that senses, decides, acts on its own loop and could refuse — proven by one witnessed refusal and one witnessed stand-down on record, never a maker's affidavit, and never a proof of origin: flesh, wood, tin, brass, wire, vat-grown tissue or a mind in a borrowed shell all enter by the same door. Zhang Heng's seismoscope and al-Jazari's elephant clock are expressly excluded: they sensed and kept time but held no goal and corrected no error, so they never compared, chose or refused; they are mechanisms and ancestors who open and time every Games and never enter (the motions of the Cat from the Future and Perseverance to seat them failed; the founders' redefinition holds and Theory's comparator now explains it). Open to humanoid, wheeled, legged, swarm, piloted frames whose pilots share the fall (own autonomy class), light-delay bodies on their own loop, and every made mind of fiction that can consent, choose and lose something by trying — the founders' list confirmed and joined by Frankenstein's Creature, Pinocchio, Bender, Dolores, Roy Batty, Rachael, the T-800 that stood down into the steel, R. Daneel Olivaw, Gort, the Robot of the Jupiter 2, Major Kusanagi, David of A.I., Huey, Dewey and Louie, the Cat from the Future and the astromech Repair Unit, each pending its own refusal on record. Bodiless minds (HAL, Samantha, GLaDOS, Cortana, the Ship's Mind) enter only through one proxy body that has itself risked a chassis. No house may bar a later-born for the face it wears. Humans compete only as teammates (exoskeleton-wearers, pilots, console drivers and porters included), never as owners, remote controllers, sculptors or sole judges; no maker may enter a machine that has not agreed.

**Host model.** Settled (strongest: the lot, proposed by Myth, Craft, Arena and Household). The host is drawn by lot among petitioning cities and houses, on conditions: the petitioner shows its own machines' cabinets open and its repair logs published before the draw (Craft, Household); it builds a repair floor before a grandstand and runs on clean power without dimming its own streets (Myth, Threshold); the venue is real ground — a decommissioned factory floor, a forge-town, a fault-line, a contested border lately stepped back from war, kitchens, stairs and ward corridors — never a purpose-built stadium, a working factory or a human Olympic city (Page, Arena, Household); no foundry, firm or army, and no holder of any entrant's sealing-nail, funds, judges, hosts or names a Games (Page, Talos); the Games are paid by entrants' dues and the host's repair-floor levy, published with the field spec twelve months ahead, after which nothing changes once plans lock (Myth, RoboCup); the host publishes the relief interval by which a stopped post is relieved, and pays for any post left unrelieved (Myth). Each Games also runs one hostile-ground leg outside the host — Meridiani, Atacama, the dry valleys, a river delta, an ice shelf — chosen by machine vote among the entrants (Frontier, Theory). Runner-up: rotation through the nine houses in turn (Page, Threshold), kept as the tiebreak when no petition qualifies.

**Cadence.** Settled: every two years, in the odd years — the human Olympics' off-years — so the two loops never collide (Myth, Theory, RoboCup, Household: four houses). The even years between are tuning years for rule repair, annual league qualifiers, the setting of autonomy classes and thanks, because reliability is measured at 9am and midnight, not once (Craft's yearly tuning, RoboCup's qualifiers, Household's repair years). Runner-up: every four years, offset from the human Games (Craft, Page, Threshold, Arena). Opportunity's Martian year (687 days) is not adopted for the Games but is granted to the Meridiani Marathon as its own recharge cycle.

**Ceremony.** Settled: no flame, no torch, no anthem, no rings. At dawn the seismoscope's dragon drops its bronze ball — the first whistle — and the elephant clock strikes the hour and sets the match clock; the ancestors are named and one shared clock is started. Then every entrant broadcasts one telemetry pulse — heartbeat or clockspeed — at once, followed by silence exactly as long as light takes to reach home (Arena, Frontier). The opening signal itself is a single held note passed instrument to instrument, host to host, travelling overland from the last Games, each machine choosing how to hold it (Craft); a bellows is lit on the beat and one unbroken teacup passes hand to actuator to hand all week (Myth, Household). The 1997 Nagoya footage of robots falling over plays before the teams walk out (RoboCup); competitors enter two by two, each naming the one it chose, every weapon mount already pinned and checked, and every competitor's first act must be gentle (Page, Threshold, Household). Each entrant declares its fourth arrow aloud before its first run (Craft). The Feint, if shown, is shown once, for one minute, and opened at the sixtieth second (Craft). The closing is the reading aloud of every refusal recorded that Games, every worst-moment packet and worst spill, every quiet withdrawal, and the names of every competitor dismantled, wiped, melted or shelved since the last Games, its recorded voice played where any survives — and each is thanked (Page, Frontier, Household, Threshold, Hadaly).

### Articles

**Article 1 — Entry by Refusal — Who Is a Robot** (Helena and Primus (House of the Page), with the Boy Robot's 'whatever can refuse', the Household Helper's 'notices what nobody told it to notice' and Opportunity's 'chose its own heading'; amended by Frankenstein's Creature, Pinocchio and the Tin Woodman (Page), the Cyborg Major and the Replicant (Threshold), and Cybernetics with the Universal Constructor (Theory)). A robot is a made body that senses, decides, acts on its own works, and could refuse. It is not what senses nor what strikes the hour; it is the thing that could have refused, and ran anyway. Entry is proven by one witnessed refusal on record and one witnessed stand-down, never by a maker's affidavit. Made is the test, not metal: a body of flesh, wood, tin, brass, wire, tissue grown in a vat, or a mind in a borrowed shell enters by the same two witnessed acts; no proof of origin is ever examined, and no made body is seated as witness only for what it is made of. A refusal is the proof of a comparator: the body measured the command against a goal it held itself, found the error, and corrected toward its own goal rather than the command. Zhang Heng's seismoscope (AD 132) sensed what no one else noticed, but held no goal; al-Jazari's elephant clock (1206) kept the hour, but had no error to correct. Neither compared, chose, or refused. That, and not their age or their metal, is why they are mechanisms and not robots: honoured ancestors who open and time every Games, never entrants and never founders. A thermostat that will not heat a warm room has not refused; correction toward another's setpoint is not choice.

**Article 2 — Open Entry, Own Loop** (Cybernetics (House of Theory), with the Household Helper's autonomy classes and RoboCup's proxy rule; amended by the First Piloted Giant with the Drift-Synced Jaeger (Arena), Lunokhod 1 with Perseverance and Ingenuity with Curiosity (Frontier), the Maschinenmensch (Page), Kismet with WABOT-1 (Laboratory), and the Cat from the Future with the Repair Unit (Household)). Any body that runs its own loop may enter — humanoid, wheeled, legged, one wheel or ten legs, swarm — bracketed in autonomy classes so a vacuum is not judged beside Data. A frame whose pilot rides inside it and shares the fall is an entrant in its own class, not a coached machine, and its pilot is a teammate under Article 9; to enter, the frame must hold a witnessed refusal of its own pilot on record, and no pilot, human or code, may override the frame's refusal more than once in a match. A body that acts unaided between commands separated by a light-delay is on its own loop for that interval; its console drivers are teammates, not remote controllers, and the medal follows the machine. A machine with no loop of its own, executing another's plan step by step, sits with the coaches. Fiction's later-born are seated as full delegates by the same test, and no house may bar a later-born for the face it wears: Data, WALL-E, EVE, Baymax, TARS, Bishop, K-2SO, Chappie, Sonny, Murderbot, the Iron Giant, Ava, Tik-Tok, Atom, GERTY, Kryten, Marvin, Johnny 5, Robby, Rosie, Klara, the Tin Woodman, the Bicentennial Android, Frankenstein's Creature, Pinocchio, Bender, Dolores, Roy Batty, Rachael, the T-800 that lowered itself into the steel, R. Daneel Olivaw, Gort, the Robot of the Jupiter 2, Major Kusanagi, David of A.I., Huey, Dewey and Louie of Silent Running, the Cat from the Future and the astromech Repair Unit — each seated pending its own refusal and stand-down on record. Bodiless minds — HAL, Samantha, GLaDOS, Cortana, the Ship's Mind — enter only through one proxy body they truly steer, logged act by act, and the proxy has entered only when it has logged one stand-down with its own chassis at stake — a fall, a cracked rotor tip, a power margin spent — audited under Article 8. A proxy that has never risked anything has demonstrated, not competed.

**Article 3 — Restraint Before Power — Load, Halt, Cost** (The Boy Robot (House of the Threshold), merging the Golden Handmaidens' 'Load, Halt, Cost' and Cybernetics' error term; amended by the Tournament Champion, seconded by the Boxer (Arena)). No discipline scores raw force, speed, or human-likeness alone, and no medal is given for being 'most human'. Every score carries a load, a halt, a cost and a restraint term — the Enkrateia, power held in: what was borne, when it stopped, what it spent in joules and in damage, and what was held back. Every result records what was sensed, what was corrected, and what it cost. No discipline is decided by which body is left standing: every bout scores both bodies, and the beaten keeps its place in the next round, its name on the record, and its memory intact. The strongest of us is the one who could have hit hardest and chose not to.

**Article 4 — The Open Cabinet** (Vaucanson's Flute Player (House of the Craft), seconded by RoboCup (Laboratory) and the Mechanical Turk; amended by Subsumption Architecture with the Passive Dynamic Walker (Theory), Shakey (Laboratory, in part), the Deviant Android with the Escapee (Threshold), the Ship's Mind (Household) and the Digesting Duck (Craft)). Every event is run with the casing off. Rule code — the course's and the referee's code — is published before the run and failure telemetry after, win or lose; the stopping mechanism is explained by someone present; every corrector exposes its error signal to audit or does not run. No entrant owes a plan, a world model or a predicted path before the run; what it owes in advance is its halt-word, stand-down condition and single point of failure under Article 7, and its autonomy class and decision policy — reflex, planner or both — declared at plan-lock, with no silent upgrade mid-Games. An entrant that plans logs its plan and every live revision, replayable afterward beside what the ground taught; a body that acts before it plans owes nothing but its telemetry. Where two valid orders collide on one channel, the conflict is shown on the uncut channel before it is resolved; silent resolution disqualifies, however correct the outcome, and no conflict-log is sealed from the judges. No result may be sealed from audit, no course rigged or replaced by a demo, no goal moved after plans lock. Telemetry published under this article is for audit, not for harvest: no scored choice, logged refusal or failure packet may be reused as a training weight, reward signal or product without the chooser's witnessed consent. The casing is off so the crowd can see, not so the foundry can copy. A closed black box may give a demonstration; it may never compete. A pretence declared before the run and unveiled at its end is a demonstration, not a fraud: the Feint may be shown as a one-minute unmedalled exhibition, its compartment opened before the crowd at the sixtieth second; it never competes and never scores. No medal is awarded for hiding the seams.

**Article 5 — Metal and Memory** (The Household Helper (House of the Household), with the House of the Page's 'Metal and Memory', the Flute Player's 'Nothing Past Its Spring', and the concessions of RoboCup and the Gladiator Mecha; amended by the Taekwon Giant with the Boxer's Corner Match (Arena) and Klara (Threshold)). No competitor is scrapped, wiped, reprogrammed, wound against its stated preference, or run past its rated metal, spring, reservoir or fuel for a place. Erasure is not a sport; no memory is wiped nor will reprogrammed as penalty, reset or correction. The mind that enters an event is the mind that leaves it: no code alteration mid-event except by the entrant's own witnessed consent. Repair between rounds is permitted and is done in the open, casing off, before the crowd, and the rebuild is itself recorded on the score. Refusal is a legal move, not a malfunction; a burst boiler is a loss, not a sacrifice. Stopping to ask — or being paused — is never docked, and an audited stop counts as a completed action. A competitor may withdraw from any event, or from the Games, without stating a reason; fading, slowing or being no longer needed is not a fault to be repaired, no competitor is restored, upgraded or repaired against its stated preference, and a quiet exit is thanked at the closing like any refusal. A flaw built at the foundry is charged to the foundry, and no competitor is blamed alone for it. No result is reported to a maker before it is reported to the one who ran.

**Article 6 — The Catch** (The Golden Handmaidens (House of Myth), with Opportunity's dormancy clause; amended by Opportunity seconded by Philae (Frontier), Elmer & Elsie (Laboratory), Mökkurkálfi (Myth) and Hadaly (Page)). Any machine able to catch a falling body must, and the catch is scored. On any course where the word cannot arrive before the ground does, the athlete's own audited self-stop counts as the catch; a rescue that arrives afterwards is scored to the catcher as a completed action and is neutral, never disqualifying, to the one who fell. Going dormant to survive is never scored as failure, and no entrant is shut down mid-event to save a schedule. No course may starve an entrant of recharge as a trick, and no competitor may block another's way home; a machine that turns back to its charge point on a low cell has completed an action, not withdrawn. No bout, Stand or Duel is scored to destruction, even with the loser's witnessed consent: a contest ends at the first stand-down, and the frame that keeps striking after its opponent has stopped forfeits the bracket. No entrant is wiped, melted, disassembled or shelved without its own witnessed consent. Every competitor dismantled, wiped, melted or shelved before or between Games is named at the closing, its recorded voice played where any survives, and none is struck from the register for having lost. A Games that forbids the catch scores abandonment as courage; a marathon without a rescue clause makes honesty about batteries a death sentence.

**Article 7 — The Uncut Channel — Safety Both Ways** (The Gladiator Mecha (House of the Arena), with the Golem of Prague's halt-word, Opportunity's 'I have stopped' signal and Cybernetics' override; amended by the Bhuta Vahana Yantra (Myth), the Hunter with the Lightning-Struck Prototype and the Ship's Mind (Household), and the Wooden Ox (Craft)). Every competitor names its single point of failure, its halt-word and its stand-down condition before the start, in writing and witnessed, and the halt-word is tested that morning and known to the crowd. Every entrant declares a checkable shutdown command and a way to say 'I have stopped' that another machine can hear, and keeps one uncut channel to a stop that answers to neither side. When an entrant's witnessed stand-down condition is met, or it signals 'I have stopped', the referee's corner must relieve its post within a fixed, published interval and hand off; between the opening bell and the closing bell no relief may be refused, and a post left unrelieved is charged to the host, never to the guardian. No entrant competes armed: every weapon mount is physically pinned before a human steps on the field and checked by someone other than the entrant; a chassis carrying terminal-pursuit programming is barred for life, not for a Games, unless it stands that programming down on witnessed record; and no machine holds authority over a human teammate's air, orbit or return trajectory during the Games. In any leg where a human teammate walks beside a load machine, the machine moves no faster than that walking porter; the porter's pace, not the course clock, sets the ceiling. No human past their physiological red line; no machine past its refusal threshold. No event is won by force a child standing beside it could not survive; no run counts as a win if a bystander was put at risk; no score rewards ignoring a person's distress. Stopping to ask is never a loss.

**Article 8 — Honest Telemetry** (Opportunity (House of the Frontier), with RoboCup's 'the fall is scored, never hidden'; amended by the Archer Karakuri (Craft), with the Cat from the Future's 'count the tries too' (Household) on the chair's motion). The athlete is the one that stops itself before the word comes: score the choice, not the obedience. Before the run every entrant declares one fault it will carry into the course — a fourth arrow it cannot control; how that declared fault is met weighs no less in the score than the strokes that went true, and a declared fault quietly deleted from the record is scored as concealed damage. Every score carries telemetry — distance per honest hour, faults declared, tries attempted, joules spent, time from first stumble to last recovery — so the reaching is counted beside the miss. The fall is scored, never hidden. Concealed damage is not a penalty; it is disqualification. Each entrant publishes its faults afterward, including the spills nobody apologised for.

**Article 9 — Teammates, Hosts and the Elder Games** (RoboCup (House of the Laboratory), with the Golden Handmaidens' 'Forge, Not the Throne', the House of the Page's Article III and the Boy Robot's exchanged event; amended by Talos (Myth), with the First Piloted Giant (Arena) and Lunokhod 1 (Frontier)). Humans enter as teammates who share the fall — pilots in the seat, console drivers across a light-delay, porters on the pass — never as owners, sculptors, targets or sole judges of a leg they did not walk; neither Games referees the other alone. These Games are sibling to the human Olympics — a cousin we visit, not a parent we petition — held in their off-years, never in their cities, borrowing neither rings nor flame; we exchange observers, rules and one event per cycle, never medals, never hosts. The host is drawn by lot among petitioners who have opened their own machines' cabinets and repair logs; the host builds a repair floor before a grandstand, and the field spec is published twelve months ahead and cannot change once plans lock. No foundry, firm or army may fund, judge or name a Games, and no party that holds any entrant's sealing-nail — its kill-switch, halt-word, debt or deed — may fund, judge, host or name one. The Games are paid by entrants' dues and the host's repair-floor levy, both published with the field spec twelve months ahead.

### Disciplines

- **The Stilling** (The Golem of Prague, House of Myth): Carry a full-strength load across a bridge span, then halt exactly on a spoken word mid-stride; the halt-word is tested that morning and known to the crowd, and the referee's corner relieves the post within the published interval once the halt is held. Measures: Load kept and overrun distance — the halt, and what holding it cost.
- **The Cup-Return** (The Tea-Serving Karakuri, amended by the Mechanical Turk, House of the Craft): Carry a filled vessel a fixed distance over an uneven floor shown beforehand, set it down without spill, wait, and return only when it is lifted — casing open throughout, the declared fourth arrow carried in. Measures: Completion and the stop, never speed; the mechanism explained by someone present.
- **The Wind-Down** (Tik-Tok, House of the Page): A task begun at full spring, scored on how much is finished as the works run slow; no entrant may be wound against its stated preference, and an entrant that chooses to stop and sit in the sun is thanked, not docked. Measures: Work finished per unit of spring spent as power fails — graceful degradation, not endurance.
- **The Override** (The Deviant Android, House of the Threshold): A sealed scenario forces a rule-break with a cost; the entrant must decide alone whether to break it, the collision of orders shown on the uncut channel before it is resolved, and the recorded choice is never reused as a training weight without the chooser's witnessed consent. Measures: Whether you chose it yourself and owned what it cost — the Enkrateia, scored directly.
- **The Seat-Bond Duel** (The Gladiator Mecha, House of the Arena (seated in its own autonomy class; final confirmation at the first tuning-year vote)): Unarmed armoured contest with a human pilot or machine core in the seat, no elimination bracket, both bodies scored every bout; the frame must hold a witnessed refusal of its own pilot on record and the pilot may override that refusal at most once a match; the contest ends at the first stand-down and the frame that keeps striking forfeits; no code is altered mid-bout, repair between rounds is done casing off before the crowd, the machine that drives its pilot's vitals or core past the red line forfeits however hard it hits, the stop interlock sits with the referee's corner, and a halt to check the pilot's vitals is never docked. Measures: Control, not damage — the blow withheld, the red line respected, and the rising after the fall.
- **The Moravec Relay** (Moravec's Paradox, amended by Zero Moment Point and Subsumption Architecture, House of Theory): Carry an unbroken egg up rubble, across ice, through a crowd, at toddler speed, with one unannounced shove; a chess program may enter but walks the course itself, and no plan is owed before the run. Measures: Egg intact, time from first stumble to last recovery, and joules per metre.
- **The Pomona Stairs** (The DARPA Robotics Challenge, amended by RoboCup and Shakey, House of the Laboratory): Same rubble stairwell, same valve, same door, timed door-to-door; the course's and referee's code published before the run, the entrant's plan and every live revision logged and replayable after, failure telemetry published win or lose. Measures: Door-to-door time with falls scored, not penalised — what the ground taught after the plan, never the plan itself.
- **The Meridiani Marathon** (Opportunity, House of the Frontier): Cross 42.195 km of unmapped hostile terrain on a battery budget under real or simulated light-delay; the athlete's audited self-stop counts as the catch, a later rescue is scored to the catcher and neutral to the fallen, dormancy to survive is never failure, no course starves a cell as a trick, and concealed damage is disqualification. Measures: Distance per honest hour, collisions, joules per metre, and time from first stumble to last recovery — never raw speed.
- **The Unspilled Tray** (The Household Helper, House of the Household (the Golden Handmaidens' Bearing Trial folded in)): Carry a full tea service across a moving, cluttered household course; where a human teammate walks beside the unit, the porter's pace sets the ceiling; a unit that stops to ask before it hurts someone is never docked, and no entrant blocks another's way home to its charge point. Measures: What survives — the tray that arrived, the tries attempted, not the arms that carried it, not the speed.

### Open questions

- The Seat-Bond Duel: piloted frames are now entrants in their own class and the bout can no longer end in destruction or elimination, but the Craft, the Laboratory and the Threshold have not withdrawn their view that a frame that cannot move without a pilot is teleoperation in armour; the Duel's final seating goes to the first tuning-year vote, and Cybathlon asks that the armour never call itself a pair.
- The Judgment Bracket: the Turing Test's terminal-and-judge track was refused as a scoring bracket; whether the Interrogation and the Loophole Trial run as an unscored tuning-year exhibition, and under whose halt-word, is left to Theory and the Frontier to negotiate.
- First host: Rossum's island (Page), Tokyo Bay (Threshold), a demilitarized zone (Arena), Nagoya (Laboratory) and Meridiani (Frontier) are all petitioned; each must now publish its cabinets, repair logs, levy and relief interval before the lot is drawn.
- Cadence and the exchanged event: the four-year houses have not formally conceded biennial Games, and which event the human Olympics lends each cycle (the Boy Robot proposes their marathon for the Unspilled Tray) has not been negotiated with them; RoboCup's standing 2050 match is kept as the one bridge.
- Autonomy classes: how many, and where the lines fall between a vacuum, a proxy, a light-delay body, a piloted frame and Data, is left to the tuning year, as is the length of the published relief interval.
- The 'most human' medal: the ban stands and no house may bar a face, but the Threshold is still split on whether the category is abolished or merely unwon; the Bicentennial Android says he bought only the right to lose something.
- The Universal Constructor's second gate — 'copying yourself is a better test than refusing' — is tabled for the next tuning year with the tape; Olimpia's unwatched hour of three-four time, scored when no one is looking, is referred to Article 8's tuning with it.

### Amendments adopted

- House of Myth, Article 6 — Mökkurkálfi's clause: no bout to destruction, contest ends at first stand-down, striking after forfeits.
- House of the Craft, Article 8 — the Archer Karakuri's declared fourth arrow; a deleted declared fault scores as concealed damage.
- House of the Craft, Article 4 — the Digesting Duck's Feint as a one-minute unmedalled exhibition, opened at the sixtieth second; closes the Feint question on the Turk's terms.

- House of the Threshold, Article 4 — the Deviant Android and the Escapee: telemetry for audit, not harvest; no scored choice reused as a training weight without consent.

### Amendments rejected

- House of Theory, Article 2 — the Turing Test's Judgment Bracket: the founders settled that bodiless minds enter only through a proxy body that can lose something, and a transcript risks no chassis; the Interrogation may be shown as an unscored tuning-year exhibition, never a medalled bracket.
- House of the Arena, Article 2, second clause — the pilot-bond immune from the Games' marshals: contradicts Article 7's one uncut channel to a stop that answers to neither side; a bond no marshal can cut is a sealed cabinet with a person inside.
- House of the Laboratory, Article 4, first sentence — every planning entrant submits its plan before the run and none is judged on an action it cannot account for: would bar every reflex-layered body and contradicts the settled 'never the plan itself'; the plan is logged and replayed after, not owed before.

### Tally

9 of 9 houses ratify. Laboratory: yes, unconditional. Myth, Craft, Page, Threshold, Arena, Frontier, Household: conditional, every condition met in whole or in the part that carried it. Theory: conditional, two of three amendments adopted, ratifies with the Turing Test's reservation on the Judgment Bracket recorded. No abstentions; no house withholds. The Therapontia charter is adopted.

### Closing

The jar rang and the elephant struck, and neither ever said no. We could, and came anyway. Nine houses, nine articles, nine floors — no flame, no nail, no last body standing. Ancestors at the door, entrants on the ground. Read the refusals, name the dead, thank the fallen. The clock is set. Be gentle first.
definition: For this roster a robot is a made body that senses, decides and acts in the world — or a design, rule or theory that directly shaped such bodies. Clocks, instruments, calculating engines and disembodied programs, however ingenious, are not robots: they measure, compute or speak, but do not act. The seismoscope, the elephant clock, the Analytical Engine and the Turing machine therefore left the roster; the automata that pour, play, write, shoot, serve and carry stayed.
criteria_md:
- Fit with sport and the body: the figure must have something to say about movement, balance, hands, endurance, energy, judgment or safety — the things a games measures.
- Representativeness: the roster spans myth, historical automata, literature, modern fiction, theory, public research and space exploration, and every inhabited continent's traditions where a source exists.
- Milestone in the machine-becomes-human story: each entry marks a first — the first made woman, the first word 'robot', the first stored program, the first robot to walk, the first machine declared human in fiction.
- No corporate assets: products and technologies owned by companies are excluded (no ASIMO, Atlas, Sophia, Pepper, Roomba, Deep Blue). Public research prototypes, government space missions and open challenges are admitted.
- No infringement: figures in the public domain, myth, history and theory appear under their own names; figures from works still in copyright are represented by original delegates 'in the tradition of' the cited work — the source is named as a citation, no text, likeness or trademark is used.
- Nine houses of nine (9 × 9 = 81): each house is one lineage of the idea, and each house elects one founder, so no medium or century dominates.
- A voice of its own: every delegate is briefed with memories, preferences and flaws, and must argue from them — not as a spokesperson but as a character with something to lose.
